jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Work Based Learning
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

 **Title:****Program Coordinator \- YAWL Work Based Learning**

**Salary:****$30\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full\-Time, (40 hours/week), Non\-Exempt**  

  

**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16\-24\. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  

  

**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Work Based Learning portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate subsidized internships, recruiting local SF businesses/employers to partner as a worksite and provide support to worksite supervisors and participants throughout the internship period.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Partnerships/Event Planning
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Support agency\-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination, internship coordination, and development
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low\-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community\-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high\-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.

jobs.description:
The Health Education Program Coordinator manages and implements health education programs, develops community education and outreach activities, and counsels patients.




**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**




* Develops, implements, coordinates, and evaluates bilingual health education programs and activities on preventative health care, chronic disease management, Western medicine, and other related topics
* Develops curricula, toolkits, health education programs and materials
* Provides group class and/or one\-on\-one health education services to members and the general public
* Acts as primary liaison with appropriate community agencies and schools to establish, promote, and carry out community education and outreach programs
* Manages Health Education centers
* Counsels patients on a variety of subjects such as diabetes, hypertension, asthma, smoking cessation, substance abuse, teen health, Hepatitis B, preventive cancer screening and immunization, etc.
* Coordinates with clinical departments to develop multilingual educational material
* Reviews translations of materials for accuracy and appropriateness
* Researches grants and funding opportunities, and assists in writing grant proposals
* Collects, tabulates, analyzes program data, and prepares reports
* Works collaboratively with Administration and Project Management Department, and provides support in health information projects such as activity schedule, newsletter, informational displays, flyers posters, staff bulletin, community health events, etc.
* Travels to NEMS’ clinic site to conduct programs and events
* Supervises summer interns and volunteers and assists in implementing education activities for the Health Center Week
* Provides day\-to\-day operational support to Health Education Assistants including scheduling, training, and guidance; acts as a liaison to communicate updates or concerns to Health Education Manager as needed
* Supports walk\-ins and provider referrals to Health Education
* Administers Remote Patient Monitoring assignment, monitoring, tracking and calls
* Calls outreach lists tied to organizational goals and PIP measures, as needed
* Assists with ad hoc outreach lists (e.g., health plan initiatives or incentive programs that require patient outreach), as needed
* Covers and rotates to other sites as required
* Performs other job duties as required by manager/supervisor




**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree (degree in public health or related field preferred).
* Health \& Wellness Coach Training completed by a NBC\-HWC\-approved program or ability to obtain it within 6 months of first available training date is required
* CHES certification preferred
* Two years’ experience in community health education, health communication or related field preferred
* Prior experience in program planning, design and implementation that incorporates evidence\-based strategies and cultural competency
* Experience with formative research or program evaluation preferred
* Prior experience working with the underserved, immigrant, low\-income and/or Asian communities preferred
* Current documentation of Basic Life Support is required




**LANGUAGE:**




* Must be fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking)
* Must be fluent in Chinese: Cantonese and/or Mandarin (reading, writing, and speaking)




**STATUS:**




This is an FLSA Non\-exempt position.


This is not an OSHA high\-risk position.

jobs.description:
**Note:If you are a current employee, please apply through the internal career page.**


IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status\-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.


With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well\-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.


Urgently hiring.
  

Serving as the key administrative support team member to the Enrichment Center and supporting other Companioa Programs, this role requires a highly organized and proactive individual to ensure maximum efficiency and streamline operations in a highly dynamic team. Primary duties include supporting client referral to enrollment process, client records compliance, transportation management, supply management, and program coordination.**Prospects, Tours \& Enrollments**

* Maintain a thorough knowledge of all dementia services to communicate Companioa programs effectively and accurately to referral sources, prospects, and other visitors to the Enrichment Center.
* Receive all incoming calls to main line at the Enrichment Center \& provide response within 1 business day.
* Facilitate tours of the Enrichment Center for prospects and referral sources as needed and conduct timely follow up after tour to identify next steps.
* Proactively engage Director as enrollment barriers arise.
* Assist new client / family with Enrichment Center enrollment paperwork.
* Ensure all new clients have a successful transition to designated Companioa programs.
* Assist in completing \& submitting transit applications and supplemental documentation for all impacted new enrollees.
**Client Records \& Billing Management**

* Maintain daily attendance log with updates, notes, and client\-specific needs.
* Enter client status updates (enrollment, disenrollment, hold, etc.) and notes for all communication with prospects and clients into electronic health record within 2 business days.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records for all funder \& grant contracts using required systems.
* Completely and accurately follow client file checklists to ensure files are complete, current, and in compliance with licensing.
* Manage client roster for Enrichment Center and Care Coaching programs. This includes, providing enrollment and disenrollment information in the client health record and submitting accurate attendance reports to billing department.
* Maintain emergency rosters for all enrolled clients with a minimum of monthly updates.
* Collaborate with program liaisons at Veterans Administration, SF Department of Disability and Aging Services, and other grant/funders as needed.
**Transportation**

* Manage relationship and requests with outside transit providers, this includes assisting clients with Paratransit enrollment and coordinating requests for Group Van services, including participation in stakeholder meetings.
* Maintain transportation manifests for multiple providers.
* Document unmet and untimely service in internal logs \& communicate with vendors in real time.
**Supply \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate meal service with outside vendor to ensure accurate count of meals based on forecasted Enrichment Center attendance.
* Maintain adequate stock of program materials and supply and replenish proactively.
**Other Duties**

* Participate in daily team meetings to inform Enrichment Center staff of the anticipated daily attendance and other details regarding prospects and other visitors.
* Assist Program Director in audit readiness and ongoing monitoring tasks to ensure compliance with state licensing regulations and other service contracts.
* Maintain knowledge of all safety and emergency protocols to effectively direct staff, clients, and visitors.
* Support Enrichment Center programs, including meals and activities, as needed.
* Actively participate in Companioa and IOA meetings.
* Other duties as assigned.
**EDUCATION:**


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

**BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Five years of program or administrative experience
* Interest and ability to support older adults, particularly persons with dementia
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain effective relationships with a wide range of internal and external clients
* Team player
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift 35 lbs
* Ability to reach, bend and walk
**COMPENSATION:**

**Range:** $ 34 \- 35\.50/hourly

*This amount is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific employee, which is always dependent on actual experience, education and other factors.*

*This range does not include any additional equity, benefits, or other non\-monetary compensation which may be included.*

***APPLICATION DEADLINE: Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 5:00 p.m.***

  


***THE CITY*** is focused on enhancing our community members’ quality of life through well\-designed services and a positive workplace culture. San Rafael is the economic and cultural heart of Marin County, and its high quality of life is centered on its commercial districts, engaged neighborhoods, active lifestyle, and natural environment. San Rafael (population 60,000\) is a full\-service city with a city council/city manager form of government with 12 departments, more than 400 employees, and an annual budget in fiscal year 2026\-2027 of $208 million. The City’s vision is to be a vibrant economic and cultural center reflective of its diversity. The City Council is engaged and seeks to strengthen the urban and commercial areas as well as sustain the beautiful natural environment.


San Rafael’s Organizational culture framework is an initiative called **“Together San Rafael.”** City employees are our greatest asset, and we seek talented individuals with diverse backgrounds who are creative, curious, and excited about a challenge. We are a results\-driven team focused on the needs of community members. The **Together San Rafael initiative is focused** on modernizing City services and increasing the engagement of employees. This initiative recognizes the interconnectedness of the customer and employee experience.


***THE LIBRARY AND RECREATION DEPARTMENT*** is dedicated to enriching the lives o San Rafael residents through discovery, learning, and play through programs and services that provide high community value. The Recreation Division operates with a $4\.93 million budget and 18 FTE. Key facilities include the Albert J. Boro Community Center, Pickleweed Community Park, Terra Linda Pool and Terra Linda Community Center.


***THE POSITION:***


The City of San Rafael is seeking a full\-time Program Coordinator to join our team at the Terra Linda Community Center/Pool. You will plan, coordinate and supervise recreation programs, events and activities, including planning, scheduling and implementing recreational activities; recruit, coordinate and supervise the activities of regular, temporary and volunteer staff; prepare program budgets and monitor expenditures; administer the rental, scheduling, use and maintenance of major recreation facilities. jobs.title: Lead, Channel Enablement
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**


‎


Commercial Organization \| GTM Enablement  

Reports to: Director, GTM Enablement  

  

The Lead, Channel Enablement owns the enablement strategy and infrastructure that helps Castlight\-powered solutions get sold effectively through our channel ecosystem, including health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace relationships.  

  

This role is the Commercial owner of the second sale enablement motion and the connective tissue across Castlight, our partners, and the teams responsible for bringing our solutions to market. The Lead builds the training, demos, tools, and repeatable programs that allow partner sellers and Castlight teams to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Castlight\-powered solutions at scale.  

  

The role also owns the core demo infrastructure supporting channel selling, ensuring our Figma environments, screen libraries, and partner\-specific experiences stay current as the product evolves.
‎

**How will you make an impact \& Requirements**


‎

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Channel \& Partner Enablement**
---------------------------------

* Build and own the channel enablement strategy across health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace partners.
* Develop scalable enablement programs that help partner sellers understand the buyer problem, articulate the Castlight value proposition, demonstrate the solution, and advance opportunities.
* Create partner\-ready training programs, playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, objection handling, templates, and selling tools using Product Marketing's approved positioning and messaging.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to build tailored enablement programs based on partner type, commercial model, seller audience, and go\-to\-market motion.
* Support the launch and ongoing readiness of new partner relationships and Castlight\-powered offerings.

**Second Sale Enablement**
--------------------------

* Own the enablement framework for the second sale motion across health plan and partner channels.
* Establish one source of truth for second sale training, demos, tools, templates, and selling standards.
* Prepare Castlight Commercial and Client teams for the transition of second sale execution to Client CSMs by September 30\.
* Build repeatable training and certification approaches that allow Client teams to execute consistently while maintaining Commercial standards.
* Create scalable processes for Commercial review, feedback, and continuous improvement as execution moves closer to the client and health plan teams.

**Demo Strategy \& Engineering**
--------------------------------

* Own the core demo environments supporting health plan, partner, reseller, and second sale motions.
* Build and maintain Figma\-based demos, screen libraries, reusable components, and partner\-specific demo experiences.
* Maintain demo environments as products, capabilities, positioning, and user experiences evolve.
* Lead Nova conversions across the existing channel book and establish the standards for new partner implementations.
* Manage partner access to demo environments and establish clear governance around version control, usage, and updates.
* Coordinate external design or Figma resources as needed to maintain and scale the demo platform.
* Establish a regular operating cadence with Product, UX, Solutions, and Product Marketing so demo experiences remain accurate and current.

**Cross\-Functional Enablement**
--------------------------------

* Translate Product Marketing's positioning and messaging into usable seller training, demos, and field tools.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to understand partner priorities, seller needs, and commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Client leadership to ensure second sale teams have the tools, training, and confidence required to execute.
* Partner with Solutions and Product teams to keep demonstrations accurate and identify opportunities to improve how Castlight capabilities are represented in market.
* Bring health plan, partner, seller, and field feedback back to Product Marketing, Product, Solutions, and Strategic Partnerships to improve messaging, products, and the partner experience.

**How Ownership Works**
-----------------------

This role operates across several teams, with clear ownership boundaries:

**Product Marketing** owns core positioning, messaging architecture, value propositions, competitive strategy, and master marketing assets.

**Channel Enablement** turns that strategy into training, demos, playbooks, tools, certification, and scalable seller experiences.

**Strategic Partnerships** owns partner strategy, relationships, commercial agreements, partner performance, and escalations.

**Client CSMs** own plan\-specific second sale execution, including training delivery to health plan sellers and ongoing maintenance of client\-specific materials.

**Solutions and Product** provide product expertise, roadmap input, and validation required to keep demonstrations technically accurate.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Partner sellers can confidently explain and demonstrate Castlight\-powered solutions without relying on Castlight for every selling interaction.
* Health plan and partner channels have consistent, current, easy\-to\-use enablement resources.
* Second sale execution successfully transitions to Client teams without losing quality or commercial consistency.
* Demo environments stay aligned with the live product and can be efficiently adapted across partners and channels.
* New partners can move from agreement to seller readiness through a repeatable enablement process.
* Feedback from partner and second sale motions consistently reaches the teams responsible for product, messaging, and commercial strategy.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 4\+ years of experience in sales enablement, partner enablement, solutions consulting, product marketing support, or

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, Revenue Operations and Analytics
jobs.description:
### **About Zuora**



At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage\-based pricing to AI\-driven and outcome\-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.



We've led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we're evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI\-ready foundation.

  


### **The Opportunity**



Drive transparency, predictability, and insights to the organization through actionable GTM reporting and business intelligence at scale across all levels of the organization.


**What You'll Achieve:**


* Support our GTM strategy through a portfolio of dashboards and reports that surface actionable insights
* Build out a standardized and effective forecasting framework and review process with cross\-functional teams

jobs.title: Client Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nowadays**
==================


We're building the future of in\-person connection, from intimate exec offsites to a conference\-level company offsite.


Nowadays is the first AI\-powered platform for planning corporate events. Our software handles everything from venue sourcing to vendor negotiations, making it easier and faster for teams to meet up in real life.


We've planned events across the globe for companies like Google, Airbnb, and Quantstamp, and we're just getting started.


Our mission is simple: make it easier for teams to create meaningful moments together.

**Who we are**
==============


We're a sister\-founded team based in San Francisco. We move fast, care deeply, and love bringing people together (whether it's a strategic offsite or a Friendsgiving in our Nowadays home).


We believe the best teams:

* Take ownership
* Keep things scrappy
* Celebrate wins (big and small)
* Genuinely enjoy working (\+ hanging out) together


Some of our favorite team excursions so far:

* Flying trapeze
* Steak\-offs at home
* Hauling a Christmas tree up to the office
* Hitting the spa after a big launch
* Racing an Ironman Relay

**What this role is**
=====================


This is a **zero\-to\-one operations role**. You'll take messy, fast\-moving workflows and turn them into systems that are simple, teachable, and scalable, without losing the human care that defines Nowadays.

**What you'll do**
==================

**80% of your time will focus on event operations and client communication**

* Own events end\-to\-end simultaneously, including clear written \+ verbal on\-brand client communication
* Own and evolve the end\-to\-end ops flow for running events, from first request to post\-event wrap
* Be the point person for prioritizing urgent vs non\-urgent ops issues
* Turn tribal knowledge into clear documentation, onboarding, and templates that anyone can use

**The remaining 20% of your time will focus on building for scale**

* Build scalable playbooks for: running a single complex event start\-to\-finish, and managing many events in parallel
* Partner closely with engineering to: translate customer feedback and bugs into clear product requirements and actionable tickets, and help test, validate, and refine tools before launch
* Create and maintain internal resources: ops onboarding docs, and client\-facing guides and templates for planning offsites
* Continuously identify what should be simplified, automated, or eliminated

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* You consistently put clients first, understanding that this can sometimes require late nights or weekend work
* You can juggle multiple workstreams and know how to prioritize quickly
* You're excellent at turning complexity into clarity
* You care deeply about process, but never at the expense of momentum
* Extreme attention to detail
* You're comfortable working across ops, product, dev, sales, and clients
* You communicate clearly, thoughtfully, and with good judgment
* You like building systems that other people can run
* You want to shape how a company operates, not just follow a playbook

**Bonus points**
================

* Startup zero\-to\-one experience
* Experience working with clients \+ owning client relationships
* Strong intuition for customer experience and boundaries
* Experience writing clear tickets in tools like Linear or Jira
* Comfort with basic SQL or data analysis to answer operational questions
* Comfort using AI/tools to replace manual, repetitive work

**Other details**
=================

**Location**

* In\-person in San Francisco

**Perks**

* Free lunch \+ dinner
* Quarterly team offsites (yes, we went to the White Lotus S3 hotel in Thailand), and exclusive access to top venues and events
* Monthly fitness stipend
* Health insurance
* 12 weeks paid parental leave
* Generous PTO with required time off to recharge
* High ownership, autonomy, and direct access to founders
* Access to top venues, events, and travel experiences

  

Compensation Range: $90K \- $130K

jobs.title: IT Service Desk & SLA Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The IT Service Desk \& SLA Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of all IT support tickets, from initial intake through resolution and closure. This role demands unrelenting ownership: you will follow every ticket on its entire journey to the end\-of\-the\-earth to achieve resolution in a timely and effective manner.



Driven by a "Simple Sets You Free" mindset, this role actively strips away bureaucratic friction, eliminates operational waste, and continuously optimizes IT service management processes to maximize efficiency, speed up ticket resolution, and boost customer satisfaction.



### **In This Role, You Will...**


End\-to\-End Ticket Ownership \& Lifecycle Management
* Relentless Resolution Ownership: Personally track and follow tickets on their entire journey to the end\-of\-the\-earth, taking total responsibility until issues are thoroughly, accurately, and effectively resolved.

Queue Administration \& Triage: Monitor, triage, and assign incoming incidents, service requests, and problem tickets across multi\-tiered support teams with speed and accuracy.* Closure \& Quality Control: Validate that all tickets are properly documented, root causes are identified, and end\-users confirm resolution before ticket closure.
* Escalation Management: Identify aging, stuck, or high\-priority (P1/P2\) tickets and proactively cross organizational boundaries to drive action and prevent SLA breaches.


Process Optimization \& Friction Elimination ("Simple Sets You Free")
* Bottleneck Identification: Continuously audit ticket lifecycles, intake workflows, and escalation paths to pinpoint bottlenecks, redundant approvals, or process inefficiencies that delay issue reporting and resolution.
* Streamlined Workflows: Design and implement intuitive, simplified ticketing processes and self\-service channels that make it effortless for users to report issues and for technicians to resolve them.
* Root\-Cause Process Fixing: Collaborate across IT and business departments to re\-engineer flawed processes, remove unnecessary handoffs, and eliminate administrative bloat slowing down resolution times.
* Automation \& Lean Operations: Champion lean service desk practices by eliminating obsolete procedures, automating routine tasks, and establishing straightforward, zero\-friction standards across all support tiers.


SLA \& Metric Tracking
* SLA Monitoring: Enforce and monitor compliance against core SLAs (First Response Time, Mean Time to Resolution \[MTTR], First Contact Resolution \[FCR], and Customer Satisfaction \[CSAT]).
* Reporting \& Dashboards: Design, build, and maintain real\-time operational dashboards and weekly/monthly executive report packs using ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk).
* Trend Analysis: Analyze incident data to detect recurring technical issues, capacity bottlenecks, or process failures, feeding insights directly into Problem Management.


Process Governance \& Continuous Improvement
* ITIL \& Lean Governance: Standardize and enforce streamlined incident management processes, simplified escalation pathways, and consistent ticket categorization/tagging.
* Vendor \& Cross\-Team Coordination: Hold internal technical teams and external IT vendors accountable to contractual response and resolution targets while streamlining joint operational workflows.
* Customer Feedback: Manage the CSAT survey process, follow up on negative feedback, and implement actionable improvement plans based on direct user input.


### **Qualifications**

* 3–5\+ years in IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations, or Service Desk leadership roles with demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end ticket management and lean process optimization.
* Unwavering ownership mentality—willing to follow a ticket to the end\-of\-the\-earth to see it resolved.
* Strong lean operational mindset focused on process simplification and waste reduction.
* Advanced proficiency in ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, BMC Helix, Freshservice, etc.).
* Deep expertise in analytics/BI platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Excel/Google Sheets advanced reporting).

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification
* Excellent written/verbal communication
* Strong analytical problem\-solving
* Proven ability to simplify complex technical workflows under tight SLA timelines

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.
**About Zoox**
Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team.

Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 152 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 20 federal agencies, 45 state government agencies, and 70\+ healthcare organizations. More than 600\+ consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me's technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800\-63\-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me is committed to "No Identity Left Behind" to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.



ID.me is a full\-time, in\-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on\-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field\-based sales or other remote\-by\-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.



At ID.me, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

**About the Role**



ID.me is hiring a Manager of Sales Operations \& Deal Desk to be the operational engine behind our sales process — from pipeline hygiene and CRM administration to deal structuring and approvals. This role sits within Revenue Operations and is the day\-to\-day partner Sales reps and managers turn to for anything that touches process, systems, or deal terms. Given ID.me's consumption\-based pricing model, deals often involve non\-standard structures — usage tiers, ramp schedules, minimum commitments — that require careful review and consistent governance. This role is a strong fit for someone who's detail\-oriented, systems\-fluent, and energized by being the person who keeps sales moving efficiently without sacrificing deal quality or compliance.  

Level (Senior Analyst vs. Manager) will be determined based on the candidate's experience.


**Why This Role Matters**



Sales Operations \& Deal Desk is where strategy meets execution — every deal that closes efficiently and every clean pipeline report starts here. This role gives you direct, visible impact on how quickly and effectively ID.me's sales team can operate.


**What You'll Do**



Deal Desk


* Review and approve deal structures, pricing exceptions, discounting, and non\-standard contract terms in line with company policy
* Partner with Sales, Legal, and Finance to structure deals for ID.me's consumption\-based pricing model — usage tiers, minimum commitments, ramp schedules, and renewal terms
* Maintain deal desk approval workflows and playbooks, ensuring consistent turnaround times and clear escalation paths
* Track and report on deal desk cycle time, exception volume, and win/loss patterns tied to deal structure


Sales Operations


* Own CRM data integrity and administration (Salesforce): pipeline hygiene, opportunity stages, fields, and reporting structure
* Support territory design, account assignment, and quota allocation in partnership with Sales leadership
* Build and maintain sales dashboards and reporting for pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity
* Identify and implement process improvements across the quote\-to\-cash lifecycle, reducing friction for reps and improving data quality for Finance


Cross\-Functional Partnership


* Act as the go\-to resource for sales reps and managers on process, systems, and deal questions
* Partner with Finance/FP\&A to ensure deal terms and CRM data flow cleanly into revenue reporting and forecasting
* Support onboarding and training for new sales hires on CRM usage, deal desk process, and sales tools
* Assist with ad hoc analysis and projects as Revenue Operations scales


**What You'll Bring**


* 3\+ years (Senior Analyst) or 5\+ years (Manager) of experience in sales operations, deal desk, or a related analytical function, ideally in B2B SaaS
* Strong hands\-on experience with Salesforce (or comparable CRM) — administration, reporting, and workflow configuration
* Strong Excel/spreadsheet skills; comfort building clean, reliable analysis under time pressure
* High attention to detail and a process\-oriented mindset — comfortable being the person who enforces consistency
* Clear communicator who can explain policy and process to sales reps without being a bottleneck
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment where process is still being built


**Nice to Have**


* Experience with deal structuring for consumption/usage\-based pricing models \- Experience with CPQ tools or quote\-to\-cash process design
* Exposure to sales compensation, territory planning, or forecasting

jobs.description:
**About the Company:**

  

GreenWaste has been an industry leader in recycling and waste diversion for 40 years and is on a growth trajectory after private equity investment in 2021\. Our business was founded on principles of environmental sustainability, and innovation is a cornerstone of our ongoing operations and growth strategy. GreenWaste specializes in all aspects of material collection, processing, and sales, tailoring our service offerings to the unique needs of our customers and communities, and helping to shape the evolution of the solid waste and recycling industry. We work directly with 20\+ municipalities and 50\+ jurisdictions, operate highly regulated facilities in 10\+ locations, and have 1,000\+ employees.

**Position Summary**


GreenWaste is seeking to fill the position of **Operations Manager** to provide operational leadership and oversight for one or more post‑collection facilities. This exempt role is responsible for **translating facility and company objectives into effective operating systems**, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient performance through the leadership of Operations Supervisors.


The Operations Manager works closely with the **General Manager**, Safety, Maintenance, and cross‑functional partners to ensure **operational consistency, regulatory readiness, workforce capability, and achievement of performance, safety, and financial goals**. This position directly manages Operations Supervisors and serves as the primary bridge between strategic priorities and daily execution.


This role is based out of our Zanker Road Resource Management facility at 675 Los Esteros Road, San Jose, CA.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership \& Oversight**

* Lead, coach, and manage Operations Supervisors to ensure consistent, safe, and effective execution of daily post‑collection operations
* Translate General Manager priorities into operational plans, staffing strategies, and performance expectations
* Ensure appropriate staffing levels, coverage models, and scheduling practices are in place to meet operational demands
* Oversee coordination of sub‑haulers, vendors, and internal resources to support daily and future operational needs
* Monitor operational performance and proactively address trends, risks, or breakdowns through corrective action

**Safety, Compliance \& Training Systems**

* Support and advance the company’s safety mission in partnership with the Safety team
* Ensure consistent implementation of safety programs, PPE standards, training requirements, and hazard mitigation practices
* Provide oversight of employee onboarding and recurring training programs to ensure workforce readiness and regulatory compliance
* Audit supervisory enforcement of safety rules and standard operating procedures
* Support incident response, investigation, and development of corrective action plans
* Partner with the General Manager in preparation for regulatory inspections and audits

 **People Management \& Workforce Development**

* Directly manage Operations Supervisors, including performance management, coaching, development, and accountability
* Partner with Human Resources on recruiting, onboarding, disciplinary actions, and talent development efforts
* Ensure Supervisors are effectively leading Processing Plant Leads and hourly employees
* Promote consistency, fairness, and professionalism in employee relations and leadership practices
* Support succession planning and leadership development within operations

 **Performance, Financial \& KPI Management**

* Analyze operational reports and KPI data (e.g., throughput, safety, labor, overtime, productivity) to drive data‑informed decisions
* Manage payroll considerations and operating expenses in alignment with financial and operational goals
* Identify cost‑containment opportunities and operational efficiencies without compromising safety or compliance
* Communicate material field issues, risks, and performance concerns to the General Manager in a timely manner

* Coordinate with Maintenance to ensure equipment availability, preventive maintenance planning, and timely repair escalation
* Assist with troubleshooting operational impacts related to equipment or infrastructure issues
* Support planning and execution of facility improvements, repairs, and expansion projects
* Coordinate onsite development projects in collaboration with internal teams and external partners

**Communication \& Continuous Improvement**

* Facilitate clear and effective communication between the General Manager, Supervisors, and frontline teams
* Ensure operational standards, procedures, and expectations are clearly communicated and consistently applied
* Lead or participate in initiatives focused on safety improvement, operational efficiency, standardization, and employee engagement
* Perform other management duties as required to support facility and company objectives

 **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong leadership, communication, and labor‑relations skills
* Ability to design, implement, and sustain operational systems and processes
* Ability to read, understand, and enforce operating, safety, and compliance documents

* Education Requirement: Associate degree or equivalent experience
* Management Experience: 2 \- 3 years

Compensation is fair and equitable, partially determined by a candidate's education level or years of relevant experience. Salary offers are based on a candidate's specific criteria, like experience, skills, education, and training. Sodexo offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

* Medical, Dental, Vision Care and Wellness Programs
* 401(k) Plan with Matching Contributions
* Paid Time Off and Company Holidays

At Sodexo, our purpose is to create a better everyday for everyone and build a better life for all. At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (MS Office) tools, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Strong problem‑solving skills, with the ability to identify issues and proactively seek solutions
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team in a collaborative environment
* Demonstrated commitment to inclusion and diversity, including the ability to work respectfully with individuals from diverse backgrounds
* Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and able to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment with short timelines

* Integrity (Doing What’s Right)

jobs.description:
**Job Title** Finance and Operations Manager


**Division / Department** Business Office


**Reports To** Chief Financial \& Operating Officer (CFOO)


**Direct Reports** Finance and Operations Assistant Manager; Business Office Associate \&
  

Assistant, Transportation Coordinator


**Campuses** Three Campuses — San Francisco Bay Area


**Position Type** Full\-Time, Exempt, Open Until Filled


**Experience Required** 5\+ Years in Finance and Accounting, incl. Supervisory Experience


**Language Preference** French Fluency Preferred


**ABOUT THE LYCÉE FRANÇAIS DE SAN FRANCISCO**


The Lycée Français de San Francisco (the Lycée) is a French immersion and International College Preparatory
  

school with 820\+ students across three Bay Area campuses. The Lycée strives to maintain an international
  

community for teachers, parents, and students of diverse social and cultural backgrounds while providing a
  

rich educational environment that emphasizes academic excellence and personal achievement.


Our program is based on the highly recognized French national curriculum and IB Curriculum and framework
  

enriched by key American courses, allowing flexibility and academic transfer to leading schools and
  

universities worldwide. The Lycée is a unique environment that promotes initiative, autonomy, cooperation,
  

and individual responsibility.


**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Business Office Manager is a hands\-on leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Financial \&
  

Operating Officer (CFOO). This individual owns the integrity of the school’s accounting operations, leading
  

the Business Office team, driving an accurate and on\-time full\-cycle close, maintaining general ledger
  

accuracy including restricted and unrestricted fund tracking, and producing reliable financial reporting. The
  

Manager also oversees key operational functions across the school’s three campuses, including campus
  

security, student transportation, and insurance/risk management. This is a working\-manager role: the
  

successful candidate leads by doing, builds strong processes and controls, and raises the quality bar of the
  

Business Office through training, documentation, and accountability.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Accounting Operations \& Full\-Cycle Close**


* Own the full\-cycle monthly, quarterly, and year\-end close, delivering an accurate close on a fixed

calendar with documented checklists and review controls.
* Oversee day\-to\-day Business Office operations, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and the general

ledger in accordance with GAAP, FASB standards, and internal policies.
* Ensure expenses are coded to the correct general ledger accounts, departments, and funds; review and

approve journal entries and account classifications.
* Maintain accurate tracking, release, and reporting of restricted versus unrestricted funds in accordance

with donor intent and nonprofit fund accounting standards.
* Complete monthly bank reconciliations and ensure all balance sheet accounts are reconciled and

reviewed on schedule.
* Ensure vendor payments are accurate and on time; establish AP review controls that prevent late or

erroneous payments.
* Manage cash flow and ensure the Lycée’s cash position is optimized.
* Lead the automation of accounts payable and other manual processes; identify and implement

efficiencies across financial operations.
**Team Leadership \& Training**


* Manage, coach, and develop Business Office staff across all three campuses, setting clear expectations

and providing performance feedback.
* Develop and document standard operating procedures for all accounting and finance functions.
* Train Business Office staff and school employees on accounting procedures, expense policies, and

financial systems.
**Financial Reporting \& Analysis**


* Produce accurate and timely monthly financial reports for the CFOO, Board of Trustees, and department

managers, including statements of activities and financial position by fund.
* Assist the CFOO with the presentation of accounting and financial data to the Board.
* Reconcile project cost records and support budget variance analysis.
* Support preparation of annual operating and capital budgets across multiple departments and funding

sources.
**Compliance, Filings \& Audit**


* File and manage local property tax returns and other required filings related to school operations across

all three campuses.
* Ensure all annual, quarterly, and periodic federal, state, and local filings are completed accurately and on

time, in compliance with requirements applicable to a nonprofit educational institution.
* Lead audit preparation: year\-end schedules, adjusting entries, and responses to auditor inquiries.
* Implement and enforce accounting policies and internal controls; work cross\-departmentally to ensure

financial matters comply with Lycée policies and applicable law.
**Operations: Security, Transportation \& Risk**


* Oversee campus security operations across all three campuses, including vendor/personnel

management, coverage schedules, incident records, and functioning security systems (cameras, access
  

controls, alarms).
* Oversee the student transportation program with assistance of Transportation Specialist.
* Monitor and oversee insurance needs across all campuses; liaise with brokers on coverage sufficiency

and escalate risk matters to the CFOO and Head of School as appropriate.
* Take on other operational duties as the school evolves, which may include construction and building

projects and other cross\-functional initiatives.
**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**


**Required**


* A minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in finance and accounting, including

ownership of a full\-cycle close.
* Strong working knowledge of GAAP, FASB standards, and nonprofit fund accounting, including

restricted/unrestricted fund tracking.
* Demonstrated experience supervising, training, and deve

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor (Transportation) South San Francisco CA
jobs.description:
Hallcon is a transportation and related infrastructure services company that serves clients such as technology companies, manufacturers, railroads, universities, corporate business parks, hospitals, airports, public transportation networks and more.
  
  

Hallcon provides essential services spanning multi\-modal operations, integrated command centers, electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure, technology integration, analytics, business intelligence, fleet management, specialty cleaning, and overall rider experience performance. We are inviting the right leader to join our team and help us drive rapid growth.
  
  

The Role
  
The Supervisor supports daily transportation operations by serving as a central point of communication between customers, drivers, maintenance, and management. This role involves monitoring events, logging and filtering information for reporting, tracking ridership data, and handling various administrative tasks. The Supervisor ensures that all activities are documented accurately, communicated clearly, and handled promptly.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Coordinate daily operations by working with Operations Managers and drivers, ensuring professional communication across all levels.
* Manage yard logistics, including assigning parking stalls and electric bus chargers, and working with the maintenance team to schedule bus repairs and preventative maintenance.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for drivers reporting events, incidents, or emergencies, responding quickly and appropriately with sound judgment.
* Document and manage all incidents and customer complaints per client standards, escalating complex issues as necessary.
* Prepare and distribute time\-sensitive client reports, filtering daily events into concise, actionable information.
* Perform essential administrative duties, including manual data entry, record keeping, and tracking daily ridership data.
* Utilize Excel and Outlook for all operational reporting, scheduling, and correspondence needs.
* Ensure safety and compliance by performing field inspections (bus and driver), auditing driver vehicle inspection reports, and driver daily run reports.
* Key responsibilities are subject to change based on evolving business needs.
* Serve as back up driver in the event business and staffing needs require a backup driver.
* Knowledgeable of DOT regulations.


Qualifications, Experience and Education
  
* Possession of Commercial Driver License (CDL) B with Airbrake and Passenger Endorsement
* Must have a minimum of 1 year of commercial driving experience
* Must have and maintain a current DOT Medical Certificate
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Quick decision\-making ability under pressure.
* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
* Experience in an office or operations setting preferred.
* Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Prior experience in transportation, dispatch, or a similar administrative role is an asset.


We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, exceptional growth potential and stability, all within a professional, yet casual work environment.
  
  

Hallcon is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
  
  

Hallcon is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin.

jobs.title: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Hayward - Operations Manager OEM
jobs.description:
This position will be directed and supervised by a Department Head or General Manager. The primary responsibilities for this position will be focused on routine operational tasks and supervising others in their operational assignments. Other duties may be assigned as required by the business and/or training for career advancement. Ensure guest satisfaction and the efficient operation of the hotel by supervising back of the house operating departments in the absence of the General Manager and/or the Manager on Duty. This individual may assist the General Manager by continually focusing on achieving hotel profitability through revenue generation, cost control, guest satisfaction, and development of associates. Exempt associates are expected to work as much of each workday as is necessary to complete their job responsibilities. Management\-level associates are expected to work as much of each workday as is necessary to complete their job responsibilities; for OEM associates, overtime does apply and is calculated accordingly. The Operations Manager OEM may function to support a number of areas at the property including: Housekeeping, Engineering/Maintenance, F\&B, PBX, Bell staff, Front Office, and Banquets.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**


* At least 3 years progressive experience in a Rooms or F\&B department Hotel; or a 4\-year college degree and at least 1 to 2 years' experience in a Rooms or F\&B department at a Hotel; or a 2\-year college degree and at least 2 years of experience in a Rooms or F\&B department at a Hotel.
* Previous supervisory experience required.
* Must be proficient in Windows Operating Systems
* Must be able to evaluate and select among alternative courses of action quickly and accurately.
* Must work well in stressful, high\-pressure situations.
* Must maintain composure and objectivity under pressure.
* Must be effective in handling problems in the workplace, including anticipating, preventing, identifying, and solving problems as necessary.
* Must have the ability to assimilate complex information, data, etc. from disparate sources and consider, adjust, or modify to meet the constraints of the particular need.
* Must be effective at listening to, understanding, clarifying and resolving the concerns and issues raised by co\-workers and guests.
* Must be able to work with and understand financial information and data, and basic arithmetic functions.
* Must be able to convey information and ideas clearly.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Approach all encounters with guests and employees in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service oriented manner.
* Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Aimbridge Hospitality standards, as required by scheduling which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.
* Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which include compliance with Aimbridge Hospitality’s dress code and wearing a nametag when working (per brand standards)
* Comply and ensure adherence to Aimbridge Hospitality standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.
* Comply with certification requirements as applicable for position to include: Food Handlers, Alcohol Awareness, CPR \& First Aid.
* As applicable to the hotel, ensures the efficient operation of the hotel in the absence of the General Manager by supervising and supporting the Engineering and Housekeeping departments. Whether you're a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high\-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.


**Why Rosendin?**


**Committed. Innovative. Engaged.**


If you're looking to take career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. We are an organization built on integrity. **YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:**
--------------------------


The Assistant Project Manager is an entry\-level project management position and is expected to learn and develop competency in the Essential Duties and Responsibilities. In addition, the APM is responsible for providing administrative and construction support for our Project Management team.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
-------------------

* Manage project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, (Return for Information), and meeting minutes.
* Oversee project activities as assigned by the Project Manager, including planning, coordinating, circumventing/resolving problem areas, ensuring all company/project policies, procedures, and standards are maintained, etc.

* Responsible for creating and issuing the Subcontractors' contracts.
* Responsible for the assembly and timely delivery of the Owner and Maintenance Manuals.
* Ensure that the project quality control plan is followed.
* Interacts with subcontractors to ensure we have obtained the correct documentation and drawing for the Owner and Maintenance Manuals.
* Responsible for keeping the Warranty Log up to date.
* Attend company/project meetings with clients, subcontractors, etc., and provide project management support
* Cooperate with and technically assist field personnel assigned to the area of responsibility.
* Monitor other contractors' activities and progress.
* Responsible for creating the Job Information Sheets and establishing Job Files.
* Prepares price change orders and project reports and documentation.
* Works with payroll to ensure accurate payroll information.
* The duties and responsibilities describe this position's general nature and scope of work. This is a partial listing, and other responsibilities will be assigned based on the position's role within the business unit.


**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:**
--------------------------------------

* Knowledge of construction technology, scheduling, equipment, and methods required
* Tactful and has a professional demeanor, and ability to interact effectively with managers, employees, vendors, and others
* Strong organizational, record\-keeping, and follow\-up skills
* Strong attention to details
* Demonstrated excellence in organization and time management skills
* Identify and meet customers' expectations and requirements
* Proficient in using a computer and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.); Oracle preferred
* Prioritize and manage multiple tasks, changing priorities as necessary
* Work under pressure and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude
* Oral and written communication skills as required for the position
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and an effective team player
* Interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others


**WHAT YOU BRING TO US:**
-------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or related field
* Minimum 1 year of experience in a construction\-related role
* Can be a combination of training, education, and relevant work experience that is equivalent


**TRAVEL:**
-----------

* Up to 25%


**WORKING CONDITIONS:**
-----------------------

* General work environment \- This position is performed primarily on active construction sites. Activity includes sitting for extended periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. Work is conducted primarily indoors with varying environmental conditions, such as fluorescent lighting and air conditioning.
* Noise level is typically low to medium.
* Occasional lifting of up to 30 lbs.
* We fully comply with the ADA and applicable state law, including considering reasonable accommodation measures that may enable qualified disabled applicants and employees to perform essential functions.


Rosendin Electric is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are considered regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, age (over 40\), or any other categories protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

* ESOP \- Employee Stock Ownership
* 401k
* Annual bonus program based upon performance, profitability, and achievement
* 17 PTO days per year plus 10 paid holidays
* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
* Term Life, AD\&D Insurance, and Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Income Protection Insurance
* Pre\-tax Flexible Spending Plans (Health and Dependent Care)

jobs.title: Program Manager, Consumption Products
jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**



Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.



By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.


**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**



Box is expanding into a new era of monetization, one that blends our trusted subscription model with dynamic, consumption\-based pricing for AI\-powered and Platform capabilities. As the Program Manager, Consumption Products, you will own the day\-to\-day operations of this early\-stage but high\-priority business, sitting at the intersection of product, finance, analytics, and our customer\-facing teams. This is a rare opportunity to build something new at scale: you will help define how Box monetizes AI Units today and lay the operational foundation for expanding consumption\-based models across our Platform and beyond.



This role reports to the VP, Renewals and Consumption and carries direct visibility with Box's Chief Operating Officer and other senior leaders. You will work across an exceptionally diverse set of teams \- from Product Management and Data Engineering to Billing, Marketing, and Account Teams serving as the connective tissue that keeps this fast\-moving program running accurately and efficiently.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



You will own the customer\-facing consumption program at Box globally. As the owner, you will:


* Monitor daily customer consumption, overage trends, and program activity, identifying accounts that require action and driving unresolved issues to closure.
* Coordinate and execute operational actions including exception handling, managing customer controls, advising on account\-specific treatments, and providing validated data for periodic customer reporting and billing.
* Serve as the first\-line subject matter expert for consumption billing questions from Account Teams and GTM stakeholders, providing timely guidance on program mechanics, alerts, and commercial considerations.
* Work with Business Analytics and Product teams to investigate new usage patterns and new reporting capabilities, translating business requirements into clear, actionable requests for analysts and data specialists.
* Review product updates and policy changes to assess operational impact, and contribute to internal playbooks, FAQs, and customer\-facing guidance.
* Act as the cross\-functional orchestrator across work\-streams converting ambiguous problems into clear decisions, owners, and action plans — while maintaining an integrated view of dependencies across product, billing, analytics, marketing, and customer communications.
* Lead the expansion of consumption billing to new products at Box


**WHO YOU ARE**



You love building from scratch and leaving your mark. You are someone who excitedly brings structure to chaos, with the ability to connect disparate dots and discern signal from noise. You are incredibly detail oriented with a "GSD" mindset, while always keeping the big picture in mind. Where others see problems, you see solutions. You always put the customer in the center of your decision making. If this sounds like you, you also likely have the following experience:


* You have 4\+ years of experience in management consulting, program management, operations, or a cross\-functional business role, ideally within a consulting firm, SaaS or technology company.
* You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and familiarity with consumption\-based or usage\-based pricing, including AI\-driven products.
* You have clearly demonstrated quantitative analysis experience, comfortably bring able to perform moderate analyses' and interpreting data prepared by others
* You communicate clearly and concisely in both written and verbal form, with the ability to simplify complex policies, workflows, and commercial terms for diverse audiences.
* You have strong attention to detail when handling customer\-specific terms, exceptions, alerts, and operational actions.


Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.



At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**



We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. jobs.title: Workplace Readiness Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Visions**



Visions Management began in 2007 with the goal to reimagine the experience of move management, space planning and FF\&E services for our clients. To meet this goal, we built a diverse team of experts from varied backgrounds. Visons is a Certified Women Business Enterprise, Small Business, San Francisco Local Business Enterprise and EcoVadis Gold Medalist (Universal Sustainability Award).



We believe company culture is key to the professional and personal growth of our employees. Visions Management is committed to inspiring our people as a family first company offering an environment that promotes continued education, training, coaching, creativity and bringing ideas to life.



We look forward to learning about you!  

  

**About the Team**



Visions’ embedded teams work onsite supporting their client with a variety of services, including move management, event support, space and occupancy planning and more. Team members are uniquely positioned to work within their client’s systems and processes, while delivering the excellent service and results that are emblematic of Visions. The employees who make up the Embedded vertical rise to meet the challenge of representing the excellence of Visions for their client.

 **About the Role**



The Workplace Readiness Project Manager supports the planning, coordination, and execution of workplace projects and transition initiatives, with a focus on People \& Culture (P\&C), Front Office operations, employee experience, and workplace readiness.



This role serves as a key coordination point across project teams, internal stakeholders, vendors, and employees to ensure workplace initiatives are organized, well communicated, and successfully executed. The Workplace Readiness Project Manager will manage project documentation and schedules, coordinate operational readiness and move activities, support employee communications and engagement, and help drive projects from planning through go\-live.

  

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and collaborative, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the creativity to develop practical solutions that enhance the workplace and employee experience.

 **Responsibilities –**

 **Project Coordination \& Stakeholder Management**


* Coordinate project plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, decisions, deliverables, and action items across P\&C and Front Office workstreams.
* Coordinate stakeholders and facilitate project meetings, ensuring decisions, responsibilities, and next steps are clearly documented and communicated.
* Gather and synthesize stakeholder feedback, identify gaps or potential issues, and coordinate resolution with project leadership.
* Prepare status reports, readiness updates, executive summaries, and other project communications.
* Maintain accountability across stakeholders and workstreams to support timely completion of project deliverables.
* Manage and coordinate external vendors, including schedules, deliverables, responsibilities, follow\-up, and issue resolution.

  


**Workplace Readiness \& Operations**


* Coordinate workplace readiness activities for Front Office spaces, shared amenities, workplace services, and other employee\-facing operational needs.
* Support the development and implementation of workplace procedures, service standards, operational guidelines, and readiness plans.
* Develop, document, and help establish workplace best practices, processes, and service standards that support efficient and consistent operations.
* Coordinate vendors, responsible owners, testing, walkthroughs, punch\-list items, and operational handoffs leading up to go\-live.
* Support furniture\-related planning and coordination, including understanding furniture layouts, employee needs, installation requirements, and readiness of workspaces and shared areas.
* Help ensure spaces, services, and operational processes are prepared for a successful employee transition.
* Apply creativity and problem\-solving to workplace challenges, identifying solutions that balance functionality, employee experience, operational needs, and project requirements.

  


**Employee Communications \& Engagement**


* Support the development and coordination of employee communications, FAQs, guides, orientation materials, and move\-related resources.

Ayoob \& Peery is a locally owned mechanical contractor based in San Francisco.

Our focus is in wet side mechanical building systems, including general plumbing, steam heating, hydronics, and fire protection. As a design/build firm, we provide solutions for projects of all stages – from early design and development to construction and operations.

We are seeking to fill a **Plumbing Project Manager** position on our project management team in San Francisco.

The Plumbing Project Manager will lead all phases of commercial plumbing construction projects, from pre\-construction and buyout through final closeout. This role directly contributes to project success by owning financial performance, managing schedules, and fostering strong relationships with clients, general contractors, and field teams. Ultimately, the Plumbing Project Manager will ensure complex plumbing systems are delivered safely, on time, and under budget, contributing to the company's overall profitability and reputation for high\-quality installation.

All positions available include competitive pay and benefits package.

Job Responsibilities:

* Lead and manage all aspects of assigned commercial plumbing projects, ensuring they meet financial, quality, and safety goals.
* Develop, track, and manage project budgets, including accurate forecasting, cost\-to\-complete analysis, and monthly WIP (Work in Progress) reporting.
* Negotiate, estimate, and process change orders with clients, general contractors, and subcontractors.
* Collaborate with plumbing superintendents and field foremen to develop, monitor, and update project schedules and manpower loading.
* Lead the project buyout process by negotiating and issuing purchase orders for plumbing fixtures, pipe, valves, fittings, and sub\-tier trades (e.g., insulation, core drilling).
* Oversee and mentor Assistant Project Managers (APMs) and Project Coordinators in the processing of plumbing submittals, fixture cuts, RFIs, and document control.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, attending job walks, OAC (Owner\-Architect\-Contractor) meetings, and leading project presentations.
* Identify and mitigate potential project risks, design clashes, and schedule delays before they impact the job.
* Partner with the safety team to ensure strict adherence to all project safety plans, especially regarding trenching, rigging, and job site hazards.
* Oversee the successful turnover and closeout of projects, including punch lists, warranties, and O\&M manuals.

Job Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or equivalent experience (candidates who have transitioned from the trades as a Journeyman/Master Plumber are highly encouraged to apply).
* 5\+ years of proven experience as a Project Manager specifically focused on commercial plumbing construction.
* Strong working knowledge of the California Plumbing Code (CPC) and standard industry practices.
* Strong financial acumen with a track record of successfully managing project P\&L and billing cycles.
* Proficiency in construction management and estimating software (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, ERP systems).
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Advanced ability to read, interpret, and identify discrepancies in complex plumbing blueprints, isometric drawings, and specifications.
* Familiarity with construction scheduling software (e.g., MS Project, Primavera P6\).
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Valid driver's license, with the ability to travel to various job sites throughout the Bay Area.

* Dental insurance

* Vision insurance

Title: QA Technician  
Full\-Time \| Non\-Exempt \| Hourly

POSITION OVERVIEW

Department: Quality
