jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist, Servicing
jobs.description:
**About Us:**


At Parafin, we’re on a mission to grow small businesses.  

  

Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, but traditional banks often don’t have their backs. We build tech that makes it simple for small businesses to access the financial tools they need through the platforms they already sell on.
  

  

We partner with companies like DoorDash, Amazon, Worldpay, and Mindbody to offer fast and flexible funding, spend management, and savings tools to their small business users via a simple integration. Parafin takes on all the complexity of capital markets, underwriting, servicing, compliance, and customer service for our partners.  

  

We’re a tight\-knit team of innovators hailing from Stripe, Square, Plaid, Coinbase, Robinhood, CERN, and more — all united by a passion for building tools that help small businesses succeed. Parafin is backed by prominent venture capitalists including GIC, Notable Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Ribbit Capital, and Thrive Capital. Parafin is a Series C company, and we have raised more than $194M in equity and $340M in debt facilities.  

  

Join us in creating a future where every small business has the financial tools they need.

**About the Position**


We are looking for a Servicing Specialist to support our merchants each day. This role will be a critical operator of the company's product suite by providing a positive payment experience for the small businesses we support. You will be responsible for running and building best\-in\-class processes for payments, fraud, and servicing, and work directly with our Servicing Ops Lead to solve problems for hundreds of thousands of merchants. You will always have a seat at the table, given a platform to share your thoughts and suggestions for improvement!


Are you a customer\-obsessed operational problem solver excited to work at a fast\-growing startup to help grow small businesses? If so, come join us!

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Investigate and resolve issues in the areas of processing payments, creating alternative payment plans, error handling, and other related tasks to ensure full payment collections.
* Provide quality service to small business owners via email, SMS, and phone, with a focus on debugging and resolving payment issues.
* De\-escalate scenarios and present resolutions for tough\-to\-navigate situations.
* Identify and track payment issues to ensure transparency and decrease missing payments over time.
* Provide necessary documentation, details, and evidence in a timely manner to ensure all payment issues are addressed.
* Review and respond to payment disputes, gathering documentation and evidence to represent Parafin's position with bank and card network partners
* Monitor transaction activity for fraud indicators or anomalous patterns, escalating high\-risk cases per policy in a timely manner
* Work with the Customer Support and Funding teams to build feedback loops and processes in servicing customers.
* Work directly with management and product ops managers for ongoing improvements of the merchant experience, including but not limited to systems, process, and product\-level improvements.
* Work in a startup environment with the goal to strive for improvement with both the quality and method of the interaction with merchants.
* Review current processes and provide feedback on how to improve the function, question the status quo as well as call out inefficiencies to address.
* Support other product functions with your specialties as needed.

**What We’re Searching For:**

* 2\+ years of experience with loan servicing
* Strong understanding of payments, ACH failures, and return codes
* Experience reviewing and resolving payment disputes/chargebacks, including compiling evidence and representing cases to banks or card networks
* Familiarity with transaction monitoring — identifying fraud signals, unusual account activity, or high\-risk patterns and escalating appropriately
* Excellent communication skills
* Thrive in an entrepreneurial environment
* Data\-driven approach to monitoring and optimizing recovery rates
* Desire to have an impact, grow your career, and be a game changer in the space for Parafin

**We Prefer If You Have:**

* Experience working in a fintech startup.
* Experience building a team and processes from the ground up
* Fluency in (or desire to learn) data analysis skills and tools, such as SQL / R / Python

**What We Offer**

* Salary Range: $118k \- $123k
* Equity grant
* Medical, dental \& vision insurance
* Unlimited PTO
* Work from home flexibility
* Commuter benefits
* Free lunches
* Paid parental leave
* 401(k)
* Employee assistance program

 **If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please contact us.**

jobs.description:

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in product marketing, brand marketing, corporate/internal communications, management consulting, Google Ads sales or sales enablement, or a related field.
* 3 years of project management experience working across cross\-functional teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience translating high\-level strategies into polished assets alongside creative partners, video producers, and agencies.
* Experience in, experimenting with and leveraging emerging AI tools to optimize daily workflows or enhance creative output.
* Sharp critical thinking and creative investigative skills to structure and resolve complex operational issues.
* Strong background in Google Ads products, sales tech, or market trends, with an active drive to simplify sellers' day\-to\-day workflows.
* Proven track record as a versatile all\-rounder managing multiple workflows and shifting priorities in changing environments.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Creative in Marketing, you bring visual, design, written and experiential acumen to Google products and services, presented across all major media, content, channels, and experiences. You have the ability to perform your role in a flexible, ever\-changing environment and must be open to new influences and inspiration. You will work with a deeply cross\-functional team and inspire a team of vendor partners by sharing ideas and developing effective solutions to generate multiple concepts supporting all forms of major media. You will be equally comfortable making; rolling up your sleeves and designing, mocking, writing, or prototyping; showing, not telling. Above all, you will inspire and lead by example by making the most of every opportunity to develop breakthrough creative, consistent with the Google Marketing brand, and be able to take and provide clear direction and creative feedback that pushes work forward.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Would you like to be part of an ISV sales team focused on transforming education alongside the most prominent ISV companies in the global Education market?  

  

Our EdTech ISV sales team supports the largest and most impactful Education Technology companies in the world as they strive to transform learning experiences and outcomes through application of AI and emerging technologies. We are looking for an Account Manager to work closely with a named set of enterprise EdTech ISV customers to drive growth and innovation with them. You will be responsible for establishing and fostering relationships, while generating and launching new opportunities across multiple accounts. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong bias for action, customer obsession, and a track record of consistently delivering results. This individual should possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to earn trust at the CXO level, various business stakeholders (Product, Finance, etc.), as well as with software developers, engineers, and IT architects. Come join our team and help us transform the way we learn, teach, and develop the next generation of students and professionals.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Collaborate across all levels of the customer's organization, from C\-suite executives to engineering, product management, and sales. Success in this role requires creative systems thinking and the ability to build relationships throughout the account. You'll execute collaboratively with extended teams to address the full spectrum of ISV customer needs.  

  

As an AWS Account Manager, you'll own the strategic relationship and develop comprehensive strategies for customer adoption and AWS service deployment. Working hand\-in\-hand with AWS resources, including executives, partners, support teams, and solution architects. You will champion customer interests while balancing business objectives. This includes dotted\-line responsibility for driving partnership and technical collaboration across the organization.  

  

* Drive adoption of AWS’ full suite of services into a portfolio of enterprise ISV customers
* Exceed annual revenue and design win targets
* Drive levers for growth of the business: inclusive of Account Plans, GTM programs to drive adoption of our ISV partners’ products, working closely with marketing and the partner teams
* In partnership with Sales Ops, manage all operational aspects of the business; SFDC, etc.
* Develop long\-term strategic relationships with AWS Executives and Partner management teams
* Embrace and drive the Amazon culture; lead through our Leadership Principles

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

* 5\+ years of technology/software sales experience
* Bachelor's degree, or experience in a relevant field
* Experience leveraging AI tools in a field sales role

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with direct field experience selling software or cloud solutions
* Experience in enterprise commercial sales
* Experience working in the Education market

jobs.title: Sr. Learning Experience Lead, Onboarding & Enablement
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

  

Replit is building a modern, AI\-native learning function, and we're looking for a Sr. Learning Experience Lead to own it. You'll own our learning platform and the onboarding and enablement experiences that run on it: designing them, delivering them, turning them into durable on\-demand learning, and proving they work. This is a builder\-leader role. You'll design learning, facilitate it live, build it into the platform, and measure its impact, and you'll do much of that hands\-on, in the tools, the way a modern builder works.

  

You'll start close to home and grow the mandate. Your initial focus is owning the onboarding experience for our Support organization, taking it end\-to\-end and turning it into a real, tracked, repeatable system. Over time, you'll elevate onboarding and enablement beyond Support to the broader company, partnering with our People team, with the learning platform as the vehicle.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the learning platform. As its DRI, you own the roadmap, the learning journeys, and the instructional design behind them. You make the calls and own the outcomes.
* Support onboarding, end\-to\-end. Facilitation, the live\-to\-on\-demand pipeline, and the role\-based journeys that get new team members confident and productive fast.
* Create content and learning plans. Prescriptive learning paths and the content that fills them.
* Own measurement criteria and data\-driven results: The layer that proves onboarding and enablement change behavior and speed ramp, not just completion rates, with the tracking and feedback loops that keep it healthy over time. As the mandate grows.
* Grow the platform and the learning function as adoption expands, raising the bar for how people learn at Replit.

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------

* Deep L\&D / learning\-experience expertise. You've designed and run learning programs, not just authored content, and owned outcomes whose impact was visible across an org.
* A builder. You turn ideas into working things with modern tools (you've built learning apps, LMS experiences, or similar yourself) and you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for a perfect spec.
* A track record of leading multi\-person, cross\-functional efforts. You've stood up onboarding, cohort programs, or learning paths from scratch. You think about end\-to\-end experiences and create learning journeys that people actually use and love.
* Facilitation chops. You can run the room live and convert what happens there into durable, on\-demand content.
* A measurement instinct. Pre/post, behavior change, co\-designing metrics with the leaders and ICs who live with them; a healthy skepticism of vanity surveys.
* Someone who quickly masters new domains and is comfortable with ambiguity on a small, fast, generative team where everyone builds.

  

**Bonus Qualifications**
------------------------

* Hands\-on with AI\-native build tools (Replit) or modern no\-/low\-code app builders.
* Micro\-learning and cohort\-based program design; an experiment\-and\-report\-back philosophy.
* Experience extending learning experiences across an org.
* Coaching or manager\-development background.

*This is a full\-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in\-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.*

**Full\-Time Employee Benefits Include:**


Competitive Salary \& Equity


401(k) Program with a 4% match (*US Only*)


Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance


Short Term and Long Term Disability


Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave


Flexible Time Off (FTO) \+ Holidays


Commuter Benefits (*In\-Office \& US Only*)


Monthly Wellness Stipend


Autonomous Work Environment


In Office Set\-Up Reimbursement (*In\-Office Only*)


Quarterly Team Gatherings


In Office Amenities (*In\-Office Only*)

* Self\-driving Company
* Replit Agent at Scale
* AI Adoption
* Build Open\-Source Apps

* Operating Principles
* Reasons not to work at Replit

=======================================================


**Posting Number:** \#2162


**Position Title:** Program Coordinator

The Public Health Institute (PHI) is an independent, nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting health, well\-being, and quality of life for people throughout California, across the nation and around the world. As one of the largest and most comprehensive public health organizations in the nation, we are at the forefront of research and innovations to improve the efficacy of public health statewide, nationally, and internationally.



PHI was distinguished as one of the top 50 “Best Non\-Profit Organizations to Work For” by the Non\-Profit Times in a national search.

  


##### **POSITION SUMMARY**



The Public Health Institute (PHI) serves as the National Program Office (NPO) for the Pediatric Environmental Health Specialty Units (PEHSU), funded through the CDC. PHI, as the national program office, facilitates and amplifies the capacity of the PEHSU network to prevent/mitigate hazardous environmental exposures during fetal, childhood, and adolescent development, and the preconception period.



The Program Coordinator provides essential administrative, project management, financial, event, and communications support for the PEHSU’s Childhood Cancer and the Environment Program activities to ensure effective day\-to\-day operations. jobs.description:
**ISSA is seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Associate contractor to directly support Health Coach Institute (HCI), part of the ISSA family of brands.** **While this position is posted through ISSA’s career network, your day\-to\-day focus, campaigns, and audience engagement will be dedicated specifically to HCI's programs and student lifecycle.** **This is a fixed\-term contract position scheduled through December 2026\.** **About HCI:** At Health Coach Institute (HCI), we empower purpose\-driven individuals to transform lives through human\-centered, science\-based coaching education. For over a decade, we’ve set the standard in health and life coach certification by blending behavioral psychology, habit\-change methodology, and practical business skills. Whether your goal is to build a thriving private practice or earn top\-tier industry credentials, HCI provides the accredited training, hands\-on practice, and ongoing support you need to make a meaningful, lasting impact.**So What's the Job?**  

As the **Lifecycle Marketing Associate contractor,** you will provide executional support to the Sr. Brand Manager, turning the lifecycle marketing and promo strategy into deployed reality. The Associate builds, QAs, and sends email and SMS campaigns in HubSpot, keeps the lifecycle nurture program updated/running day\-to\-day, and grows into owning audience segmentation over time. This is a hands\-on execution role, not a strategy\-setting one — strategy is set by the Sr. Brand Manager; this role makes it happen on schedule and error\-free.* **Campaign Execution \& QA:** Build, QA, and deploy email and SMS campaigns in HubSpot—including promos, webinar sequences, nurture flows, and one\-off sends—on schedule and error\-free.
* **Testing \& Optimization:** Design and run A/B tests across email/SMS campaigns and audience segmentation to optimize performance.
* **Email Calendar Management:** Build and maintain an organized month\-to\-month email calendar to ensure strategic clarity and operational alignment across the organization.
* **Lifecycle Nurture Execution:** Execute and manage the email/SMS lifecycle nurture framework (0–30, 30–60, 60–90, and 90\+ day segments) as defined by the Sr. Brand Manager.
* **Nurture Program Development:** Build and launch new nurture workflows to support evolving business and marketing needs.
* **List Hygiene \& Segmentation:** Build, maintain, and continuously improve audience segmentation and list hygiene as HubSpot data models and properties evolve.
* **Webinar Comms Management:** Support the six\-email webinar communications sequence (from registration confirmation through replay delivery) end to end.
* **Deployment QA Discipline:** Thoroughly QA every send before deployment, including link verification, personalization tokens, segmentation/list targeting, and deliverability fundamentals.
* **Promo Calendar Support:** Assist with promo calendar execution—including banners, send scheduling, and adherence to payment links and pricing structures.
* **Performance Monitoring \& Reporting:** Track core campaign metrics (open rates, click\-through rates, conversion rates) and flag anomalies or opportunities to the Sr. Brand Manager. Pull and analyze email performance data on a month\-to\-month basis to track overall email health, deliverability, and channel engagement trends
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner with the broader marketing and social media teams to ensure campaign timing and messaging remain cohesive across all channels.

**What is ISSA/HCI looking for?*** **Hands\-on HubSpot Expertise:** Experience building and deploying email/SMS campaigns and automated workflows directly in HubSpot (hands\-on execution, not observational experience).
* **Track Record of Execution:** Proven ability to take a brief and deliver a fully built, thoroughly tested, and deployed campaign with minimal supervision.
* **Strong Segmentation Aptitude:** Comfortable working directly with audience lists, custom properties, and behavior\-based segmentation logic.
* **High Attention to Detail \& QA Discipline:** Meticulous approach to quality control—success in this role is judged on error\-free sends, not just on\-time deployments.
* **Exceptional Organizational Skills:** Ability to keep campaigns, timelines, and deliverables structured and on track in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable navigating a fast\-moving, evolving marketing calendar with shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
* **Proactive Communication:** Clear, effective communicator who actively flags blockers, risks, and QA issues well in advance of send dates.

**Nice to have:**

* Prior experience specifically with lifecycle/nurture email programs (not just one\-off campaign sends).
* Familiarity with email deliverability fundamentals (sender reputation, list hygiene, spam triggers).
* Experience supporting webinar or live\-event communications sequences.
* Exposure to SMS marketing platforms/compliance basics (opt\-in/opt\-out handling).

**Success in this role looks like:*** Every scheduled send goes out on time, correctly segmented, and free of broken links or personalization errors.
* The Sr. Brand Manager can hand off a campaign brief and trust it will be built and deployed without rework.
* Growing ownership of segmentation strategy — from executing existing segments to proposing improvements.

 **Compensation:** $40 an hour**Hours per week:** 40

jobs.title: Member Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value\-based model in obesity treatment.

  

Since launching Direct\-to\-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app\-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

 **ABOUT THE ROLE**


A Member Care Coordinator sits at the intersection of Member Experience and Clinical Operations. The role of a Member Care Coordinator is to ensure that members receive timely, coordinated, and high quality care; acting as the “glue” between the Clinical, Coaching, and Operational teams. They ensure smooth handoffs between teams, including but not limited to, tracking lab results, medication approvals, and any necessary follow up to ensure members proceed through their journey seamlessly.

 **This is a full\-time, hourly role with a hourly rate of $20\-22 per hour. We are offering three different shifts:**

  

* Monday \- Friday 8am \- 4:30pm ET
* Monday \- Friday 9:30am \- 6pm ET
* Monday \- Friday 10:30am \- 7pm ET

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Execute critical clinical administrative workflows focusing on resolving readiness barriers to accelerate members toward provider review and medication access.
* Own member escalations, including issue resolution and member communication.
* Facilitate provider workflow efficiency by preparing clinical documents and proactively triaging member needs for specialty support.
* Facilitate structured handoffs of critical information to Clinical and Coaching teams to ensure timely follow\-up regarding changes in medication, denials, or approved exception paths.
* Engage in cross\-functional meetings and work collaboratively with other departments to improve and maintain a high level of member care.
* Identify and formally report recurring systemic issues, submission errors, or trends that contribute to operational friction.
* Manage the end\-to\-end medication access workflow with complete ownership, including the proactive gathering of relevant clinical data, coordinating with clinicians for additional necessary information, complex Prior Authorization (PA) submission, denial investigation, appeal documentation, final determination and overrides when applicable.
* Proactively contact members via phone and secure message to request necessary information (e.g., previous prescription history, documentation) and deliver clarity regarding complex PA status changes or delays.
* Conduct outbound calls to insurance carriers, PBMs, and pharmacies to obtain specific case statuses, track documentation, and secure approvals.
* Ensure all communication, investigation notes, and PA statuses are accurately logged in the case management system (e.g., Zendesk, MJD) to maintain a complete and auditable member record.
* Initiate and resolve pharmacy\-level rejections (e.g., refill too soon, insurance coding errors, wrong dose dispensed) by conducting outbound calls to dispensing pharmacies and PBM help desks.
* Troubleshoot technical or administrative insurance issues that prevent successful claims processing.

 **BACKGROUND \& EXPERIENCE**

* Completion of a formal medical assisting program is highly valued. Preference will be given to candidates who hold a national certification, such as Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) awarded by the AAMA or Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) awarded by the AMT.
* Familiarity with case management systems (e.g., Zendesk), Electronic Health Records (EHR), and PA/e\-prescribing platforms is highly desirable.
* 2\+ years of high\-volume customer service, call center, or patient advocacy experience, preferably in a healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM setting.
* Demonstrated track record of managing complex, multi\-step processes where follow\-up and persistence are critical to success (i.e., comfortable making multiple calls to solve a single problem).
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the proven ability to handle challenging, escalated calls/messages with professionalism and empathy.
* Ability to meet the position’s attendance and scheduling requirements in a reliable and consistent manner.

 **SKILLS \& ATTRITBUTES**

* Demonstrated proficiency in medical terminology and clinical documentation to accurately interpret patient charts, understand treatment plans, and effectively communicate with clinical providers and payers.
* Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail in documentation.
* Proficiency in interpreting and translating complex insurance terminology for the member.
* Proactive problem solver with a self\-starter mentality.
* Ability to work independently and manage case load effectively.

 **BENEFITS**

*At Calibrate, we’re committed to putting our team members in control of their health. In 2026, we are proudly offering the following benefits:*

* Enjoy a generous paid time off policy, including multiple paid company holidays, wellness days, and floating holidays to support your work\-life blend.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefit options to keep you and your family healthy.
* Calibrate\-funded disability and basic life insurance, ensuring peace of mind during unforeseen events.
* Access to several wellness programs, including a complimentary Headspace membership, and therapy on your schedule with Headspace Care.
* Employee Assistance Program through Principal to receive counseling on a wide range of topics.
* Remote\

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------



Join the Lockheed Martin Production Operations One Lockheed Martin Transformation (1LMX) Plan to Stock (PTS) Information Technology (IT) team as an IT Business Analyst (ITBA) supporting the SAP S/4HANA Product Compliance and Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) modules.


Applies functional knowledge to the design, system integration, and configuration for critical compliance and sustainability processes, ensuring adherence to global regulations, accurate product stewardship, and comprehensive employee safety and environmental management within our SAP S/4HANA ecosystem.


The successful candidate will apply strong SAP functional expertise and regulatory knowledge to align Product Compliance and EHS processes across the enterprise. They will partner closely with business process owners, legal teams, developers, and system architects to design, configure, and implement solutions that mitigate risk, ensure compliance, and support Lockheed Martin's sustainability goals.


This position is fully remote.

**Responsibilities**


The IT Business Analyst will be a key leader in solution delivery, driving the successful design and implementation of SAP Product Compliance and EHS capabilities. Core responsibilities include:

* **Lead and Drive Functional Design:** Analyze complex global regulatory requirements and internal safety standards, leading functional design sessions to translate them into effective, integrated processes within SAP S/4HANA.
* **Solution Configuration and Documentation:** Be **accountable** for performing system configuration and executing Component Unit Testing (CUT) within the SAP Product Compliance and EHS modules. Ensure accurate configuration documentation (KCDs) is created and maintained.
* **Own Specifications and Testing Data:** Take ownership of **authoring Functional Specifications (FRICE)** for all enhancements and integrations. Furthermore, be **responsible** for creating and preparing necessary test data for both Component Unit Testing (CUT) and Functional Unit Testing (FUT).
* **Coordinate Testing Cycles:** Execute Functional Unit Testing (FUT) and actively support business process owners during Integration Testing Cycles (ITC) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including identifying appropriate test data and resolving issues.
* **System and Process Guidance:** Serve as the functional expert, providing authoritative guidance on system best practices, optimal configuration, and process design for regulatory and safety compliance.
* **Manage Development Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with ABAP developers and technical teams to author and review technical specifications, ensuring that standardized, scalable, and technically compliant solutions are built.
* **Ensure Regulatory and Technical Adherence:** Coordinate with internal teams to ensure all designed solutions adhere to both Lockheed Martin's business standards and technical requirements.
* **Support Readiness and Deployment:** Prepare comprehensive documentation and training materials, support final data validation, and manage production readiness activities for all Product Compliance and EHS deployments.
* **Improvement and Backlog Management:** Identify opportunities for process improvement, recommend SAP innovations to increase efficiency and compliance, and utilize Jira and SAP Focused Build to manage backlogs and requirements throughout the Agile lifecycle.
**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* Experience authoring functional specifications based on business requirements and translating them into technical design deliverables.
* Experience collaborating with ABAP developers and technical teams to design and standardize integrated functional solutions.
* Ability to analyze compliance and safety data, identify process gaps, and facilitate data\-driven decisions that improve risk management.
* Experience supporting end\-to\-end system implementation including requirements gathering, blueprinting, development, testing, and go\-live.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving and analytical skills involving the integration of multiple IT systems and regulatory content feeds.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills with the ability to translate between technical, functional, and legal/regulatory audiences.
* U.S. Citizenship required, as this role supports systems related to national defense.
**Desired Skills**
------------------


* **Hands\-on configuration experience** with:
* **SAP S/4HANA Product Compliance** (especially Dangerous Goods, Product Marketability and Compliance, and SDS Management).
* **SAP S/4HANA EHS** (especially Incident Management, Risk Assessment, and Environmental Management).
* Familiarity with the integration points between Product Compliance/EHS and other core SAP modules (e.g., Materials Management (MM), Production Planning (PP), Sales and Distribution (SD)).
* Strong functional understanding of regulatory requirements (e.g., REACH, RoHS, GHS/CLP, OSHA) and how they are mapped into SAP compliance and EHS modules.
* Experience with **regulatory content integration** (e.g., utilizing services from external content providers).
* Understanding of **Substance Volume Tracking (SVT)** and management of chemical inventories.
* Experience with **data validation** and master data dependencies for compliance objects (e.g., specifications, listed substances).
* Experience using **Jira** and **SAP Focused Build** to manage backlogs, requirements, and testing.
* Ability to independently lead design and testing across integrated regulatory and safety systems.
* Experience in Agile or hybrid ERP delivery environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for both business and technical stakeholders.

**About MJM Financial Partners**

At MJM Financial Partners, we believe financial planning is about much more than investments—it's about helping individuals and families make confident financial decisions that allow them to focus on what matters most.

As an independent financial planning practice, we are committed to delivering exceptional client experience built on responsiveness, trust, professionalism, and personalized service. Every interaction with a client should reflect our commitment to making financial planning organized, proactive, and effortless.

**Position Summary**

The Client Experience \& Operations Manager is a key member of the MJM Financial Partners team and serves as the trusted business partner to the Financial Advisor. This is a part\-time, fully remote position designed for a highly organized professional who can work independently while maintaining consistent communication and follow\-through.

This individual partners directly with the Financial Advisor to ensure clients receive an outstanding experience from their first interaction through every stage of the financial planning relationship. The role combines client relationship management, business operations, project coordination, and executive partnership into one highly visible position.

Success in this role means anticipating needs, driving execution, creating capacity for the Financial Advisor, and ensuring that every client interaction reflects the firm's commitment to excellence, responsiveness, and a bias for action.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Client Experience**

* Own the client service experience from initial inquiry through ongoing relationship management.
* Coordinate meetings, follow\-up, annual reviews, and client communications.
* Ensure every client receives timely, proactive, and professional service.

**Business Operations**

* Coordinate all new client onboarding activities, including account openings, applications, required documentation, and workflow tracking.
* Maintain CRM accuracy and monitor operational processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and client experience.

**Executive Partnership**

* Track action items from client meetings and ensure commitments are completed.
* Coordinate travel, conferences, presentations, and business logistics.
* Serve as an extension of the Financial Advisor by anticipating needs and driving execution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience supporting a business owner, executive, or financial advisor.
* Financial services, wealth management, banking, insurance, or professional services experience strongly preferred.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote environment, maintain responsiveness, and manage priorities with limited day\-to\-day oversight.
* Reliable internet access and an appropriate professional workspace for confidential client and business communications.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* High level of professionalism, discretion, initiative, and accountability.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate enables the Financial Advisor to spend more time serving clients and growing the business by ensuring that operations run smoothly, clients receive exceptional service, commitments are consistently executed, and MJM Financial Partners continues to deliver a first\-class client experience. In a remote environment, success also requires proactive communication, dependable availability during agreed working hours, and disciplined follow\-through on priorities and deadlines.

Pay: From $28\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

**Field Operations Supervisor**

**Position:** Field Operations Supervisor  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Salary:** $29 \- $31/hr

**About Power Direct Energy**

Power Direct Energy is a nationwide field marketing and customer engagement company specializing in direct\-to\-consumer outreach for energy, utility, and other programs. Our field teams engage customers where they live, work, and participate in their communities.

We are looking for a highly organized, accountable **Field Operations Supervisor** to oversee the day\-to\-day performance of our Brand Ambassador and field Quality Assurance (QA) teams across multiple programs and markets.

**The Role**

The Field Operations Supervisor is responsible for making sure our field teams are **properly staffed, scheduled, prepared, deployed, and performing to expectations**.

This is not simply a scheduling position.

You will recruit and coordinate Brand Ambassadors, manage field schedules for both Brand Ambassador and QA teams, understand the requirements of multiple client programs, monitor field activity and results, and hold team members accountable for performance.

Most importantly, you must be able to **understand the numbers coming back from the field, explain what they mean, identify problems, and take action to improve results.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Field Team Management**

* Recruit, interview, hire, and onboard Brand Ambassadors as program needs change.
* Maintain adequate staffing levels across multiple markets and programs.
* Schedule and deploy Brand Ambassadors according to program requirements.
* Coordinate schedules and market assignments for field QA personnel.
* Communicate daily and weekly expectations clearly to field teams.
* Manage call\-outs, schedule changes, coverage issues, and other day\-to\-day staffing challenges.
* Hold field personnel accountable for attendance, professionalism, productivity, and performance.

**Program Execution**

* Develop a strong understanding of each assigned program, including its objectives, geography, field procedures, KPIs, schedules, and reporting requirements.
* Make sure Brand Ambassadors and QA personnel understand exactly what they are expected to accomplish before entering the field.
* Coordinate field deployment based on program priorities and performance.
* Ensure field teams are following established procedures and client requirements.
* Identify operational issues quickly and make adjustments when necessary.

**Quality Assurance**

* Coordinate and manage field QA activity.
* Ensure QA personnel know where and when they need to be in market and what they are responsible for verifying.
* Review QA findings and address performance or compliance issues with field personnel.
* Identify recurring problems and recommend changes to training, staffing, deployment, or procedures.
* Work closely with operations leadership to maintain consistent field quality across programs.

**Results \& Performance Management**

The Field Operations Supervisor is **accountable for understanding and managing the results produced by their field teams.**

Responsibilities include:

* Monitor daily and weekly field production.
* Track performance against program goals and KPIs.
* Review results by program, market, team, and individual Brand Ambassador.
* Identify underperformance and determine the cause.
* Recognize high\-performing team members and best practices.
* Take corrective action when performance falls below expectations.
* Verify that reported activity is complete and accurate.
* Be prepared to clearly articulate field performance to management, including what happened, why it happened, and what is being done next.

We don’t just want someone who can report that a market missed its goal. We want someone who asks **why it missed the goal and what needs to change to improve it.**

**What We’re Looking For**

The ideal candidate is an organized, proactive person who enjoys managing people and can keep multiple moving pieces under control.

You should be comfortable working in an environment where schedules, staffing needs, markets, and priorities can change quickly.

You should also be someone who naturally looks at results and asks questions.

**Qualifications**

* Experience supervising employees, field teams, Brand Ambassadors, promotional staff, canvassers, or similar distributed teams preferred.
* Experience with employee recruiting, interviewing, hiring, and scheduling.
* Strong organizational and scheduling skills.
* Ability to manage multiple programs and markets simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with performance metrics, spreadsheets, dashboards, and reports.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to interpret results and explain performance clearly.
* Comfortable addressing performance issues and holding team members accountable.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and make sound day\-to\-day operational decisions.
* Experience in field marketing, experiential marketing, utilities, energy programs, canvassing, or customer outreach is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Field Operations Supervisor knows what is happening in their markets.

At any given time, you should be able to answer:

* Who is working?
* Where are they working?
* What program are they working on?
* What are they expected to accomplish?
* Is the team meeting its goals?
* What is QA seeing in the field?
* Which team members are performing well?
* Where are we underperforming?
* Why?
* What are we doing about it?

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys **organizing people, solving problems, analyzing results, and taking ownership of getting the job done.**

jobs.description:
### **About GovPilot:**


GovPilot provides cloud\-based software solutions to local governments, aiming to make our communities better places to live and work. As a mission\-driven company, GovPilot is committed to creating impactful technology that serves the public good.


We are looking for team members who take pride in their work and seek to consistently improve themselves, their skills, and their knowledge. If this sounds like you–and the type of work environment where you’d thrive–we hope you’ll join us!

### **What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary.
* Unlimited PTO.
* Flexible working hours and remote work options.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Professional development opportunities and learning budget.
* Home office and IT budget.
* Supportive team environment.
* The chance to work on innovative projects with cutting\-edge technologies.
 **The Position:**  

 We're looking for an experienced People Operations Manager to own the full breadth of HR operations for our growing organization. This person has previously managed HR for a 100\+ person company, or a comparable vertical/business unit within a larger organization, and is comfortable operating across both the strategic and tactical sides of HR — from policy and employee relations down to the details of payroll and benefits administration.


Our workforce is global and blended — a mix of full\-time employees, Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements, and independent contractors across multiple countries — and we currently operate through a PEO (Rippling). Experience navigating that kind of complexity, and comfort with the compliance nuances it creates, is essential to this role.

**What You Will Own:**

* **HR Operations \& Compliance.** Own day\-to\-day HR operations across the full employee lifecycle — onboarding, offboarding, leave administration, benefits, and compliance with federal, state, and local employment law.
* **Payroll \& Tactical HR.** Be hands\-on with the tactical side of HR, including payroll processing and troubleshooting, benefits administration, and PEO relationship management (currently Rippling).
* **Global Workforce Management.** Manage HR processes across a blended workforce of FTEs, EOR employees, and contractors in multiple countries, ensuring each classification is handled correctly and compliantly.
* **Employee Relations.** Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers on HR matters, including performance issues, workplace concerns, and conflict resolution.
* **Policy \& Documentation.** Maintain and evolve employee handbooks, policies, and HR documentation to stay current with a growing, multi\-state, multi\-country workforce.
* **HR Systems \& Reporting.** Own HR systems administration (Rippling), ensuring accurate records, and provide reporting/metrics to leadership as needed.
* **Finance Partnership.** Work closely with the CFO on headcount forecasting, compensation administration, and budget\-related HR matters.

**What You Bring:**

* 5\+ years of progressive HR experience, including prior ownership of HR for a 100\+ person company or a comparable\-sized business unit.
* Strong working knowledge of global workforce structures — FTEs, EOR arrangements, and independent contractors — and the compliance considerations that come with each.
* Direct experience working with a PEO (Rippling experience a plus).
* Comfortable and capable handling tactical HR functions personally — payroll, benefits administration, systems — not just overseeing them.
* Solid grounding across all core HR disciplines: employee relations, compliance, recruitment, performance management, compensation, and HR systems.
* Excellent judgment and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential matters.

**What Makes You Stand Out:**

* Experience in a fast\-growing startup or SaaS environment.
* SHRM\-CP or PHR certification.

**Practicals:**

* You'll report to: Chief Financial Officer
* Location: Remote (US)
* Start date: As soon as possible
* Status: Full Time/Exempt
* Hiring Timeline: We expect to keep this posting open for 4 weeks.
* Please note: GovPilot is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

**How to Apply:**  

 If you are passionate about people and eager to help scale a growing organization, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and cover letter today!

### **Application Process:**

* Screening call with a recruiter
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Team Interview
* Final Interview with GovPIlot CEO

### **Equal Opportunity Employer:**


GovPilot is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. It's important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and by providing this data, if you choose to, it will help us to stay accountable.

**Join us in creating amazing technology solutions that make a difference. Apply today!**

jobs.title: Customer Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Trilliant Food \& Nutrition is a leading manufacturer of premium coffees and powdered beverages, proudly headquartered in Little Chute, Wisconsin. With a legacy rooted in quality, innovation, and service, Trilliant delivers branded and private label solutions across retail, foodservice, and e\-commerce channels.

  




Horseshoe Beverage Company, based in Neenah, WI, is a leading ready\-to\-drink beverage manufacturer dedicated to delivering an exceptional beverage experience. By combining industry\-leading talent and cutting\-edge equipment, we drive innovation and consistently deliver the highest quality products to our customers—first and fast.

  



Our brand portfolio includes Victor Allen’s®, Dutch Bros® beverages and Nurri™, our better\-for\-you protein beverage line. We are passionate about beverages – and about building a team that’s just as energized. We invite you to explore opportunities at Trilliant or Horseshoe, to see if your talents and career aspirations may fit with our openings.

  


**Our Core Values:**

  


**Position Overview:**



The Customer Operations Program Manager serves as the strategic operational partner for assigned customers and is accountable for a standardized way of work across customer operational performance, inventory and replenishment insights, service execution, compliance, cost\-to\-serve visibility, and continuous improvement. The role is aligned to the customer not to a brand portfolio and develops deep knowledge of the customer’s systems, requirements, inventory position, replenishment processes, service expectations, and operational priorities.



The COPM connects customer data and operational signals to action. The role works closely with Sales and cross\-functional partners to identify risks and opportunities, provide actionable insights, facilitate root\-cause resolution, and ensure clear ownership and follow\-through.



For this specific customer assignment, the COPM will support Walmart and Sam’s Club and must bring demonstrated replenishment and customer operational experience supporting both Walmart and Sam’s Club. This role requires deep working knowledge of Walmart and Sam’s Club replenishment processes, systems, inventory and POS data, and customer\-specific operational requirements, including hands\-on experience with Retail Link and Nova.

  


**Responsibilities:**


**Customer Operational Partnership**


* Develop an intimate understanding of assigned customers, including customer systems, processes, replenishment requirements, service expectations, operational contacts, and business priorities.


* Serve as the primary operational partner for assigned customers in partnership with the Sales account owner.


* Establish a consistent customer operating cadence, including operational/replenishment reviews, KPI reviews, risk and opportunity discussions, action tracking, and escalation.


* Translate customer needs and operational signals into clear actions and connect work to the appropriate internal partner through resolution.


**Inventory, Replenishment \& POS Analytics**


* Monitor and analyze customer POS, store/DC inventory, in\-stock levels, weeks of supply, order patterns, MABD/fill\-rate compliance, OTIF/service performance, and other customer\-specific inventory and replenishment measures.


* Identify out\-of\-stock risk, excess or imbalanced inventory, replenishment gaps, order opportunities, service risk, and other material customer\-operational concerns.


* Perform root\-cause analysis and provide actionable recommendations to improve in\-stock, inventory flow, replenishment, service, and the cost of moving product optimally.


* Provide order/replenishment recommendations using customer demand signals, inventory position, transit and lead\-time considerations, promotions, seasonality, and customer requirements.


* Prepare customer\-specific replenishment/performance reporting and lead or participate in recurring customer replenishment meetings.


* Develop and improve replenishment tools, reporting, processes, and standard work as business and customer requirements evolve.


* Serve as the customer operations and replenishment subject\-matter expert for Walmart and Sam’s Club, maintaining deep knowledge of customer\-specific replenishment processes, systems, metrics, reporting, and operational expectations.


* Utilize Walmart and Sam’s Club systems, including Retail Link and Nova, to analyze POS, store/DC inventory, in\-stock performance, replenishment trends, order activity, and other customer\-specific operational data.


* Prepare for and lead recurring replenishment and operational performance discussions with Walmart and Sam’s Club replenishment teams, identifying risks, opportunities, root causes, and recommended actions.


**Demand \& Forecast Insights**


* Gather and translate customer POS and/or DC, inventory, replenishment, order, promotional, seasonal, and other customer demand signals into actionable insights for Sales, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.


* Provide forecast recommendations and proactively identify material changes in demand or inventory position.


* Maintain an active seat at the business table by ensuring customer and replenishment insights inform commercial and operational planning.


**Customer Operational Performance**


* Own visibility to customer operational KPIs, including OTIF, in\-stock, MABD/fill rate, inventory position/weeks of supply, replenishment performance, service performance, compliance, and applicable cost\-to\-serve measures.


* Maintain visibility to purchase\-order\-through\-delivery performance and partner with Customer Service, Logistics, Supply Chain, and other functions to identify systemic execution issues.


* Monitor applicable customer compliance requirements, deductions, chargebacks/fines, and recurring operational failures; coordinate root\-cause analysis, corrective action, and prevention with cross\-functional partners.


*

Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are hiring in Zones 2 and 3\. Zones are determined by your zip code; if you’re within 100 miles of a listed metro area (straight\-line radius), you’re included in that Zone. Please

### **Your Zone**


Check


Read more about our Benefits.  

  

  

### **Company Description**


Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise\-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.


### **Team Description**


The Company Strategy \& Operations team (CS\&O) is part of the Office of the CEO (OCEO). We partner with Dropbox’s most senior leaders to drive the CEO’s vision forward by bringing focus and structure to the company’s most important work. Our team combines strategic thinking with strong operations — we ask the right questions, navigate ambiguity, and partner with teams to help maintain alignment. Whether we’re shaping strategy, managing operating rhythms, or driving cross\-functional collaboration, we do it with clarity, humility, and impact. If you thrive in complexity and enjoy building alongside others — you’ll find your people here.


### **Virtual First**


Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in\-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on\-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.


This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5\-10% of the year or 2\-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.


### **AI Fluency**


AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.
We look for four key behaviors in candidates:
* **Ownership**: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.

* **Leverage:** You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
* **Learning:** You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.  

  

Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted.
  

Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Media Operations
jobs.description:
**WE HAVE CREATED A WORLD WHERE ART AND SCIENCE ARE BEST FRIENDS**



Known is what happens when a data science firm and a creative agency stop arguing and start collaborating. We were built from scratch with PhD data scientists and award\-winning creatives working on the same briefs, from day one. That structure earned us an Ad Age \#3 A\-List ranking, back\-to\-back Data \& Insights Agency of the Year wins, plus Emmys, Cannes Lions, Clios, and Effies across clients in finance, tech, entertainment, consumer goods, and real estate. We're distributed across the U.S. and unapologetically ambitious.



If you're tired of choosing between doing smart work and doing creative work, you'll fit right in here.


**BUT ENOUGH ABOUT US, LET'S TALK ABOUT YOU**



About the role:



The Media team continues to grow and so does our need for Media Operations experts. The Project Manager, Media Operations will establish clear processes and best practices and work with the media team to ensure we're executing flawlessly against fast\-paced timelines and complex plans. To succeed in this role will require exceptional organizational skills, strong communication skills, and the ability to work with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholder groups.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Develop robust, disciplined, and consistent processes and best practices to ensure on\-time, excellent delivery in a fast\-paced, complex environment.
* Partner with the Media Science team to proactively identify operational risks, devise solutions, and implement changes.
* Train media team members to ensure adherence to established processes and best practices.
* Solicit input from cross\-functional leads to define, document, train, and maintain best practices for agency tools.
* Act as a liaison between the Media Science team and support teams for agency tools to optimize the user experience and increase efficient use of these platforms.
* Onboard new accounts, introducing new clients and new Known team members to our systems, guiding them through the transition phase, and putting a strong operational foundation in place for day\-to\-day account management

**WHO YOU ARE AND WHAT YOU HAVE**


* 8\-10\+ years of media operations or project management experience in a fast\-paced environment, preferably a media agency or in\-house on a media team.

* Digital performance advertising (Paid Search, Social, Display/Programmatic)

jobs.title: Creative Project Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Kitsch**


Kitsch is a certified female\- and minority\-owned global beauty brand. Our products are in 32,000\+ retailers across 92 countries. We make essentials that make you feel exceptional.

### **The Role**


We're looking for a **Creative Project Manager** to join our Product Development team, reporting to the VP of Product \& Assortment Strategy. This is a full\-time contractor role, US\-based and remote, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST.


You'll be the link between Creative and Product Development. You'll own the artwork and photography workflow from the first brief to the final file. And you'll make sure our photo assets always match what's really on the shelf.

### **What You'll Do**

* Check every creative brief before work starts. Make sure it has images, copy, specs, and dieline details. Stop incomplete briefs before they slow down the team.
* Own the priority queue for the Creative team. Balance requests from Product Development, Marketing, and other teams so no designer has to guess what's next.
* Track every packaging artwork project from start to finish. Always know its status. Push it forward yourself.
* Be the source of truth for both teams. Share updates early. Clear up confusion before it becomes a delay.
* Coordinate photography samples with the office manager, so samples are never missing or late for a shoot.
* Keep Asana accurate and complete for every active project. Build timelines that match Product Development schedules.
* Spot and fix workflow problems. Bring ideas that save the team time.
* Watch for photo assets that no longer match the real product — a label change, a material swap, a formula update. Catch it first, and manage the fix from request to delivery.

### **What You Bring**

* A knack for turning a messy project into a clear one. You ask the right questions before work starts, not after.
* Backbone. You push back on unrealistic timelines or incomplete briefs, and you find a workable path.
* Comfort translating between two teams with different rhythms and priorities.
* A proactive style. You chase the next step. You don't wait to be asked.
* Rigor with Asana as the single source of truth for your team.
* A talent for building relationships across departments.
* Comfort using AI tools day to day — drafting briefs, summarizing feedback, building templates.
* A "whatever it takes" attitude. If a sample needs tracking down or a task needs updating, you do it.
* Real pride in the work. A packaging error isn't someone else's problem — it's yours to prevent.

Confined space entry training or experience.  
Current DOT physical.

Scaffold certification(s).

Fuel card and use of company truck  
Tools and equipment furnished by Industrial Access  
Continuing Education and Training available  
Advancement and career growth opportunities

60\-80 hours per week  
6\-8 weeks on, 1 week off

UTTR stands for "up \& to the right." For us, it resonates on multiple dimensions \- it's the trajectory we envision for our clients in their outcomes, our aspiration for agency growth, and the path we hope every team member carves for their own career.


‍


As a Project Manager at UTTR, you will play a crucial role in our vibrant internal marketing team. You will be responsible for overseeing and executing marketing projects, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to lead and motivate a team.


‍


### **Responsibilities:**


* Manage and oversee internal marketing projects using ClickUp.
* Assign tasks and provide detailed briefs to team members on new projects and tasks.
* Ensure all project deadlines are met and that the team is working efficiently and effectively.
* Maintain organized project documentation and track progress regularly.
* Coordinate and communicate with different departments to align on project goals and deliverables.
* Identify potential delays and develop mitigation strategies to ensure project success.
* Review work produced by the team to ensure it meets quality standards and project requirements.
* Review and provide feedback on copywriting and creatives, offering insights into what works and what doesn't in marketing campaigns.
* Occasionally write or edit copy to ensure clarity and alignment with brand voice.
* Obtain final approval from stakeholders before project deliverables are released.
* Post approved content on social media platforms, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines.
* Continuously seek opportunities to improve project management processes.


‍



### **Qualifications:**


* Recent marketing or related field graduate.
* Proven experience in project management, preferably in a marketing or digital agency environment.
* Proficiency in using project management tools, ClickUp is a plus.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking skills.
* Strong communication and leadership abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Great eye for detail and detail\-oriented with a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* Familiarity with digital marketing concepts and practices is a plus.


‍



**Working Hours:**
------------------


* We don’t care where you work, but you need to work EST, CST, MST or PST hours.


### **Why join UTTR?**


* Global flexibility: we are a fully remote team. Work from anywhere, anytime.
* Flexible vacation: take time off when you need it.
* Cultural diversity: be part of a diverse team
* Recharge days: balance between work and life.
* Diverse tech clients: work with various startups to stay creatively challenged.

jobs.title: Data & AI Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We're hiring a Data \& AI Program Manager to support a Fortune 100 technology company. This role sits at the intersection of data strategy and applied machine learning, owning the end\-to\-end data lifecycle that fuels natural language processing (NLP) applications and large language model (LLM) development. You'll define what "good data" looks like for a range of NLP use cases, build the guidelines and pipelines to get there, and partner closely with data engineering, data science, and ML teams to turn high\-quality annotated data into measurable model performance gains.


This is a full\-time position (W2 or 1099 is fine). You would be employed by Cyborg Mobile but placed with our client working full\-time there and reporting to a manager there. We're looking for someone who is a self\-starter, self\-sufficient, and able to execute with little direction. This is a remote position (Washington candidates preferred).


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Conduct market and user research to understand data needs and expectations across various NLP applications and domains
* Define data specifications, scope, and sourcing strategy for each use case and domain
* Design judgment guidelines and instructions for data annotation, validation, and quality control
* Deliver datasets, schemas, guidelines, and annotations that meet approved specifications, scope, and sourcing requirements
* Manage the end\-to\-end data annotation process
* Analyze data quality metrics (accuracy, consistency, coverage, and diversity) and turn findings into actionable recommendations
* Implement approved data quality improvement actions
* Collaborate with client data engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers to integrate annotated data into production pipelines, support LLM fine\-tuning, and evaluate model performance and impact
* Identify data gaps and opportunities; propose new data sources, methods, and features to improve data quality and model outcomes
* Communicate data vision, strategy, and results to internal and external stakeholders, including product owners, engineers, researchers, customers, and partners
* Prepare and deliver data reports, presentations, and demos using client\-approved formats and channels


**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* Experience in NLP data strategy, annotation program management, or a related data quality/linguistics role
* Strong understanding of data annotation workflows, guideline design, and inter\-annotator quality control
* Familiarity with LLM training/fine\-tuning pipelines and how annotated data feeds model evaluation
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate quality metrics into concrete improvement plans
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills — comfortable presenting to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Experience working in large, matrixed corporate environments


**Must Haves**
--------------


* Customer centric
* Good with follow through
* Has skills to build Agents, PowerBI dashboards, Sharepoint list management, coding agents like Codex, Claude Code, Github copilot

jobs.title: Adaptive Hunting & Shooting Sports Customer Success Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Adaptive Hunting \& Shooting Sports Customer Success Coordinator**

**ABOUT DIGITAL FOV, LLC**  
Digital FOV, LLC is the company behind Digital Crosshairs adaptive hunting and shooting sports technology. Our products attach to optical scopes and display the scope image on a digital screen, helping people with low vision or physical limitations participate in hunting and recreational shooting. We serve individual hunters and shooters, veterans, caregivers, families and adaptive\-sports organizations.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**  
We are hiring a warm, organized and dependable Customer Success \& Community Coordinator for a 90\-day paid part\-time pilot. You will follow up with customers, discuss how they use Digital Crosshairs in the field or at the range, identify support needs, support product/community meetings and collect permission\-based stories. Direct personal or professional hunting or shooting sports experience is strongly preferred because credibility and rapport matter.

**THIS IS NOT**  
This is not a commission sales job, a cold\-calling position or a social\-media content creator role. The purpose is customer care, relationship building and reliable follow\-through.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**  
\- Conduct thoughtful check\-in calls and emails with existing customers.  
\- Listen for customer outcomes, field or range experiences, equipment context, support needs and next steps.  
\- Accurately document conversations and follow\-up commitments in our tracking system.  
\- Route technical or policy questions to the founder rather than guessing at an answer.  
\- Identify strong customer stories and use our approved permission process before anything is shared.  
\- Invite customers to approved product\-support/community meetings and manage reminders and follow\-up.  
\- Provide a concise weekly report showing results, unresolved items and priorities.

**YOU MAY BE A STRONG FIT IF YOU**  
\- Have direct personal or professional experience with hunting or shooting sports and can discuss common terminology, field or range settings, optical scopes and customer goals without overstating technical expertise.  
\- Are an excellent listener who helps people feel respected rather than rushed.  
\- Write clear, accurate notes and reliably complete follow\-up.  
\- Can work independently within a small number of weekly hours.  
\- Are comfortable speaking with older adults, veterans, people with low vision or physical limitations, caregivers and families.  
\- Use email, shared documents, video meetings and simple CRM or spreadsheet tools confidently.  
\- Exercise mature judgment with confidential customer information and permission\-based stories.

**EXPERIENCE THAT MAY TRANSLATE WELL**  
Direct hunting or shooting sports experience is strongly preferred. Relevant backgrounds include active hunter or target shooter; range or club staff; outdoor, firearms or optics retail; guiding; competitive shooting; conservation or adaptive hunting programs; or military/law\-enforcement experience paired with recreational shooting. Customer success, recreation therapy, veteran services, nonprofit coordination or story interviewing are also valuable. The strongest candidate combines credible sports familiarity with empathy, organization and follow\-through.

**POSITION DETAILS**  
Job type: Part\-time contract pilot  
Initial term: 90 days, with potential continuation based on results and fit  
Hours: Approximately 8 hours per week; some weekday Eastern Time availability required  
Pay: $28 per hour  
Work location: Remote  
Reports to: Founder, Digital FOV, LLC

**HOW TO APPLY**  
Submit your resume and brief answers to the following four questions:  
1\. Describe a time you helped a customer, member, patient or participant feel heard and then turned the conversation into clear next steps. Please answer in 150 words or fewer.  
2\. Describe your personal or professional experience with hunting and/or shooting sports, including the settings or work that gave you familiarity with the people, terminology and equipment. Please answer in 150 words or fewer.  
3\. What interests you about helping people with low vision or physical limitations continue participating in hunting and recreational shooting?  
4\. Confirm that you can commit approximately 8 hours per week for a 90\-day pilot and have some weekday availability during Eastern Time business hours.

Digital FOV, LLC evaluates applicants based on the requirements of the role, demonstrated capability, judgment and professional fit. We welcome qualified applicants from varied backgrounds and experiences.

Pay: $28\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8\.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Describe a time you helped a customer, member, patient or participant feel heard and then turned the conversation into clear next steps. Please answer in 150 words or fewer.
* Describe your personal or professional experience with hunting and/or shooting sports, including the settings or work that gave you familiarity with the people, terminology and equipment. Please answer in 150 words or fewer.
* What interests you about helping people with low vision or physical limitations continue participating in hunting and recreational shooting?

jobs.title: Nuclear Quality Assurance Manual (QAM) Overhaul Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

WRAAB is a proudly women\-owned firm offering engineering, consulting, research \& development, and IT solutions across a range of commercial and industrial sectors. We believe real progress comes from bold ideas—so we lean into innovation and collaboration to deliver work that not only meets today’s needs but supports a sustainable future.

website : https://www.wraab.com

**Position Overview**

WRAAB is seeking an experienced **Nuclear Quality Assurance Manual (QAM) Specialist** to lead a comprehensive review, revision, and modernization of a client's Quality Assurance Manual and associated Quality Assurance Program.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience developing, maintaining, or implementing nuclear Quality Assurance Programs and will be familiar with applicable NRC requirements, ASME NQA\-1, and other industry standards relevant to nuclear facilities and nuclear\-related organizations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct a comprehensive assessment of the existing **Quality Assurance Manual (QAM)**.
* Review the existing Quality Assurance Program against applicable regulatory and industry requirements.
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, outdated requirements, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop a revised and modernized QAM reflecting the client's current organization, processes, responsibilities, and business activities.
* Ensure appropriate alignment with applicable requirements, including **10 CFR Part 50 Appendix B, 10 CFR Part 21, ASME NQA\-1**, and other applicable requirements.
* Review and update QA program elements, including:
* Organization and responsibilities
* Quality assurance program controls
* Design control
* Procurement and supplier controls
* Document control
* Records management
* Inspection and testing
* Nonconformance control
* Corrective action
* Audits and assessments
* Quality\-affecting software controls
* Training and qualification
* Quality assurance of special processes
* Evaluate interfaces between the QAM and implementing procedures.
* Develop recommendations for updating supporting QA procedures where necessary.
* Coordinate reviews with engineering, procurement, operations, project management, and QA personnel.
* Support management review and approval of the revised QAM.
* Prepare a change\-management or implementation roadmap for transitioning to the revised QAM.
* Support training and communication associated with implementation of the revised Quality Assurance Program.

Required Qualifications
