jobs.title: Senior Service Delivery Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Senior Service Delivery Analyst, you'll play a key role across revenue cycle operations, analytics, and client delivery. You'll use deep revenue cycle knowledge, Epic Clarity expertise, and advanced SQL to turn complex operational data into accurate, client\-ready insights — partnering with Customer Operations, Central Operations, and client stakeholders to surface trends, uncover defects, and drive action. This is not a traditional reporting role; you'll operate independently, make credible recommendations, and help shape how analytics support operational and client success.  



  

**What you'll do**

* Build, optimize, and maintain reporting and analytics solutions supporting Customer Operations and Service Delivery priorities
* Use advanced SQL and data modeling to extract, transform, and validate data from complex revenue cycle environments
* Apply Epic Clarity and revenue cycle knowledge to identify trends, defects, and process improvement opportunities
* Translate analysis into clear, client\-ready reporting and recommendations for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Conduct account and performance reviews that surface actionable opportunities
* Perform rigorous QA on metrics and reports to ensure accuracy and credibility
* Own follow\-up actions and drive execution against recommendations — not just analysis
* Serve as a trusted analytics partner to internal teams and client counterparts
* Contribute thought leadership and mentorship to grow the broader analytics function

**What we're looking for**

* 8\+ years of professional experience, with strong background in revenue cycle and analytics\-driven roles
* Strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations (billing, claims, denials, A/R, payment posting)
* Hands\-on experience with the Epic Clarity data model, ideally in Resolute/Hospital Billing
* Advanced SQL skills — complex joins, aggregations, transformations, and scalable query design
* Experience with Snowflake, relational databases, and reporting tools such as Power BI
* Proven ability to turn messy operational data into reliable, decision\-ready insights
* Track record presenting findings to non\-technical stakeholders and/or clients
* Strong attention to detail, independent judgment, and ability to manage multiple priorities

**Preferred qualifications**

* Epic Resolute Hospital Billing certification
* Data modeling experience in Snowflake
* Familiarity with stored procedures / T\-SQL
* Prior client\-facing analytics or service delivery experience
* Experience mentoring analysts or building team capabilities

**What success looks like**

* **First 30 days:** Ramp up on R1's data environment, reporting ecosystem, revenue cycle workflows, and existing reporting logic. Establish trust through accurate outputs and responsiveness.
* **By 90 days:** Independently own meaningful deliverables, produce client\-ready reporting with minimal oversight, identify trends that drive operational value, and serve as a trusted partner to internal and client stakeholders.

  

For this US\-based position, the base pay range is $65,478\.00 \- $96,885\.29 per year . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
This job is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan at a target of 10\.00%
The healthcare system is always evolving — and it’s up to us to use our shared expertise to find new solutions that can keep up. On our growing team you’ll find the opportunity to constantly learn, collaborate across groups and explore new paths for your career.

jobs.title: Senior Member Services & Appointment Coordination Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Overview  
Silvur Insurance is a rapidly expanding Medicare brokerage firm dedicated to serving credit union members, their friends, and families. Our agents are deeply rooted in the communities they serve—both locally and within the credit union network—delivering support through in\-branch appointments, local seminars, virtual meetings, and educational webinars.

We help members turning 65 navigate Medicare Supplement and Medicare Advantage options, and provide ongoing support during AEP for those enrolled in Medicare Advantage and Part D plans.

Job Overview  
As a Senior Member Services \& Appointment Coordination Specialist, you will take ownership of the member scheduling experience from initial contact through appointment completion. You will serve as a trusted point of contact for members, manage a high volume of inbound and outbound communications, and resolve more complex scheduling or service\-related issues.

You will also help identify process improvements, maintain high standards for CRM documentation, and support the broader Medicare Insurance team during the Annual Enrollment Period.

This is a non\-sales position and does not provide Medicare plan recommendations or licensed insurance guidance.

Key Responsibilities

* Serve as a primary point of contact for members seeking assistance with Medicare appointments.
* Manage a high volume of inbound calls and emails with professionalism, empathy, and efficiency.
* Conduct outbound calls to schedule, confirm, reschedule, and follow up on appointments.
* Take ownership of complex scheduling issues and member service concerns through resolution.
* Maintain complete and accurate documentation of all member interactions in AgencyBloc.
* Monitor appointment records and proactively address missing information, scheduling conflicts, or follow\-up needs.
* Coordinate closely with licensed Medicare Insurance Agents to support a seamless member experience.
* Escalate Medicare\-specific or licensed insurance questions to the appropriate team member.
* Identify recurring member questions, service gaps, and opportunities to improve workflows.
* Help reinforce documentation and service standards across the seasonal support team.
* Assist with onboarding or guiding other seasonal team members, as needed.
* Support basic activity tracking and reporting related to call volume, appointments, and member follow\-up.
* Comply with all CMS requirements, HIPAA regulations, and company policies.

Preferred Qualifications

* 3\+ years of experience in customer service, member services, healthcare support, call center operations, or appointment coordination.
* Previous experience handling escalated customer concerns or complex scheduling issues.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a warm and professional approach.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of calls, emails, and follow\-up tasks.
* Excellent judgment, problem\-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Experience working with CRM or appointment\-management systems; AgencyBloc experience is a plus.
* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership in a fully remote environment.
* Experience supporting older adults, Medicare beneficiaries, healthcare patients, or financial\-services members is preferred.
* Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
* Prior experience mentoring, training, or supporting other customer service team members is a plus.

* **Hourly Rate:** $17\.00–$20\.00 per hour, depending on experience.
* Seasonal employment through the end of Medicare’s Annual Enrollment Period on December 7\.

jobs.title: Oncology Account Manager
jobs.description:
Looking for a chance to make a meaningful difference in the oncology space? Taiho Oncology is on a mission: to improve the lives of patients with cancer, their families, and caregivers. Our “People first” approach means we also highly value our employees, who work relentlessly to help execute our mission. Taiho’s success is founded on ensuring we always act with accountability, collaboration, and trust. By following these guiding principles, we earn and maintain the confidence of patients, the global healthcare community, collaborators and partners, and each other. Together, we are working on cutting\-edge science and growing our portfolio and pipeline across a range of tumor types to address the ongoing and evolving needs of patients. Advanced technology, a world\-class clinical development organization, and state\-of\-the\-art facilities: these and other resources empower us to innovate and touch the lives of more and more patients. It’s our work, our passion, and our legacy. We invite you to join us.
  
Field
  
**Territory Coverage:** Preferred candidate will reside in the greater Boston Metro area; one hour from Boston proper.
  
  

**Employee Value Proposition:**  

Responsible for the on\-label promotion and sales of existing oncology products within the Taiho Oncology portfolio.
  
  

**Position Summary:**  

In this role, the Oncology Account Manager (OAM) will act as the primary point of contact for customers in the assigned geography. In this role you will meet with customers/health care professionals to understand their practices and provide information on Taiho oncology products and services. The OAM will disseminate product, disease state, and fact statements about other products, across multiple therapeutic areas, while partnering with the commercial business on various cross\-functional initiatives, driving on\-label product adoption and appropriate use. The OAM will drive sales through their face\-to\-face interactions and implementation of innovative tools and analytical processes, while working closely with regional peers, and internal/external matrix teams.
  
  

**Performance Objectives:**  

* Represents the company in a highly professional and ethical manner and fosters the Company’s reputation and image.
* Provides a high level of product expertise and customer service to all accounts.
* Calls on customers (academic \& community setting) in a specific geography, provides on\-label technical and administrative \- information on company’s products.
* Responsible for new account development within assigned geographic territory.
* Builds relationships with physicians, nurses, pharmacy, office staff and key thought leaders in assigned territory.
* Develops and executes a territory\-level business plan with specific tactics aligned to the brand strategy and designed to meet or exceed sales goals.
* Tracks sales activities and reports those activities in the CRM system.
* Serves as a role model for corporate compliance by ensuring all business practices within region are compliant with the Taiho Oncology, Inc., Compliance Code of Conduct, Policies and Procedures and all other applicable laws, regulations, policies \& procedures.
* Conducts promotional speaker programs, lunch and learns, and exhibits in the territory, when permitted.
* Confidently synthesizes and communicates complex clinical concepts in oncology/hematology to a variety of health care professionals (HCPs), including physicians, advanced practice providers, pharmacists, nurses, and others.
* Demonstrates effective account management skills and selling competencies.
* Accountable for driving on\-label product demand to ensure HCPs identify the right patient at the right time.
* Successfully completes all training classes and product certifications.
* Attends and or displays, at all relevant medical congresses and meetings as needed.
* Can develop and execute strategies to reach difficult to access HCP's and accounts in a compliant manner.
* Can effectively deliver on label product messages for several products in person and virtually.
* Demonstrates ability to manage a large geographic territory with overnight travel and occasional weekends.
* Results oriented approach to time and territory management.
* Refers requests for off\-label information to the Medical Information Request process.


**Education/Certification Requirements:**  

* BA/BS degree required.


**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

* Minimum 3 to 4 years in pharmaceutical/ healthcare sales.
* Hospital sales experience is a plus.
* Minimum of 2 years of oncology experience.
* Possesses and maintains a valid driver’s license.
* Documented sales success of meeting and achieving sales goals.
* A self\-motivating, can\-do attitude.
* Demonstrated flexibility and willingness to be coached and developed.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively collaborate with internal colleagues.


The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $170,850 \- $201,000 annually. This pay range is based on the market range for positions of this type. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including annual bonus/incentive comp plans, potential long term incentive plan, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if a candidate/employee receives an offer of employment.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description:
**This is a full\-time, flexible work from home position and** **can be located anywhere in the U.S.** **RN Compact license and CA RN license required****English/Spanish bilingual is a plus****URAC\-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC) preferred.** **Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands\-on workers’ compensation case management training.  

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Telephonic Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost\-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non\-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as prepare status updates for submittal to customers, assist in training/orientation of new staff as requested, and other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation\-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
	+ Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
	+ URAC\-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.

Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full\-time or part\-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $74,000 \- $86,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

jobs.title: Lead Consultant, Talent Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**
===================


Awayday is a private\-equity\-backed, multi\-brand operating platform in the vacation rental and hospitality services space. We partner with founder\-led and operator\-driven businesses across the U.S. to help them scale while preserving what makes them great locally. Today, Awayday operates across 13\+ states, with 55\+ brands, 1,700\+ employees, and a rapidly expanding leadership footprint.  

  

Awayday is looking for a strategy and operations leader to solve one of the company's most important scaling challenges: building an enterprise Talent Acquisition capability from the ground up.  

  

This is **not a traditional recruiting leadership** role. We are seeking a structured problem solver and builder who can take an ambiguous business problem, break it into its fundamental components, challenge assumptions, design a scalable solution, and drive it through implementation.  

  

To attract the right candidate profile for this need, we've externally titled the role, "Lead Consultant, Talent Strategy \& Operations". Internally, you will be the "**Director of Talent Acquisition**".  

  

The initial mandate is Talent Acquisition, but the opportunity is intentionally broader: this role can become a platform for future leadership across Talent, HR, Strategic Initiatives, or other enterprise functions.  

  

You will step into an environment undergoing significant change. Recruiting is currently distributed across HR Business Partners with contractor support. Your job is to assess what exists, determine what should exist, and build the operating model, processes, technology, analytics, and team needed for the next stage of Awayday's growth.**What You Will Own**
=====================

**Diagnose and Architect**
--------------------------

* Conduct a rigorous current\-state assessment of Awayday's recruiting model, workflows, capabilities, technology, and talent needs.
* Break complex talent challenges into clear workstreams, identify root causes, challenge inherited assumptions, and establish priorities.
* Design the future\-state Talent Acquisition operating model from first principles rather than simply importing an existing playbook.
* Evaluate whether current systems, including UKG Ready, are sufficient for the future state and develop recommendations for the appropriate recruiting technology stack.

**Build the Talent Acquisition Engine**
---------------------------------------

* Create scalable recruiting processes, governance, service levels, intake and calibration practices, sourcing strategies, selection standards, and candidate experience expectations.
* Build a data\-driven recruiting funnel with clear measures of pipeline health, conversion, speed, source effectiveness, quality, and business impact.
* Transition recruiting work from a distributed HRBP\-led model into a dedicated Talent Acquisition capability.
* Build and lead the organization as it scales toward three regional recruiting leaders and approximately 6\-10 recruiters.

**Solve Critical Talent Problems**
----------------------------------

* Initially focus on the leadership and operator pipeline, including Brand Presidents, Regional Vice Presidents, Owner Relations leaders, and other high\-impact roles.
* Develop proactive talent pipelines rather than relying solely on requisition\-by\-requisition recruiting.
* Partner with business and HR leaders to improve role definition, candidate calibration, assessment, and selection quality.
* Support M\&A and organic growth by identifying talent gaps and building repeatable solutions that can scale across a multi\-brand platform.

**Advise and Influence Leadership**
-----------------------------------

* Serve as a thought partner to the VP of Talent, CEO, HR leaders, and operating executives on talent strategy, organizational needs, market dynamics, and hiring decisions.
* Translate analysis into clear recommendations, decisions, and executable plans.
* Create reporting and operating rhythms that give leadership visibility into recruiting performance, constraints, risks, and opportunities.
* Balance speed and action with thoughtful judgment in a fast\-moving, private\-equity\-backed environment.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

* A high\-caliber strategy, operations, transformation, or management consulting professional who wants to move from advising businesses to owning and building an enterprise capability.
* Demonstrated success solving ambiguous, cross\-functional business problems using structured analysis and first\-principles thinking.
* Experience designing operating models, processes, systems, funnels, or scalable business capabilities from the ground up.
* Strong analytical orientation and comfort using data to diagnose problems, prioritize work, measure outcomes, and influence decisions.
* Experience leading complex projects or engagements and driving work from problem definition through implementation.
* Executive presence and communication skills sufficient to work credibly with senior leaders while also operating tactically when needed.
* A builder and ownership mentality: energized by creating structure in a chaotic environment and personally driving outcomes.
* Ability to lead and develop teams as the function grows.
* Bachelor's degree.

**Relevant Backgrounds May Include**
------------------------------------


Project Leader, Engagement Manager, Senior Manager, Principal, or comparable roles in management consulting; strategy and operations; sales strategy / sales operations; revenue operations; workforce or organizational transformation; PE portfolio operations / value creation; or internal strategy roles with a strong consulting foundation.**What You Do Not Need**
------------------------

Position Description

The Manager, Client Services \& Resolutions oversees The Future Perfect’s post\-sale client experience,

including Claims and complex client concerns that arise following a purchase. This role is responsible for

guiding issues from initial assessment through final resolution, balancing exceptional client care with sound

operational and financial judgment.

Working across Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, Logistics, and The Future Perfect’s network of artists,

designers, studios, manufacturers, carriers, restorers, and specialized service providers, this person

determines the appropriate path forward when an order does not go according to plan. Matters may

include damage, production or delivery delays, lost shipments, product concerns, repairs, restoration,

replacement parts, warranty matters, installation complications, and other post\-sale issues requiring

thoughtful intervention.

Many of the works represented by The Future Perfect are handmade, collectible, limited edition, highly

specialized, or produced using distinctive materials and processes. Resolving concerns therefore often

requires careful investigation, nuanced judgment, and close collaboration with the people who designed

and made the work.

This is a highly relationship\-driven and solutions\-oriented role. The Manager will often become a client’s

primary point of contact during a difficult moment and is expected to communicate with warmth,

confidence, transparency, and discretion. At the same time, the role requires careful evaluation of

responsibility, financial exposure, available recovery, and the appropriate level of goodwill to extend on

behalf of The Future Perfect.

The goal is not simply to resolve individual issues. This person is responsible for protecting the client

relationship, stewarding The Future Perfect’s resources responsibly, identifying opportunities for recovery

from responsible parties, and using what we learn from claims and service concerns to continuously

improve the client experience and reduce recurring issues.

matter, the client relationship, product considerations, financial exposure, and The Future Perfect’s

obligations.

Coordinate repairs, restoration, replacement parts, replacements, returns, inspections, specialized

transportation, technical guidance, and other solutions as appropriate.

Serve as the primary client contact for escalated matters, communicating difficult or complex information

clearly while maintaining confidence in The Future Perfect and moving the matter toward resolution.

Draft, review, and approve sensitive client\-facing communications, ensuring that they are calm, warm,

transparent, solutions\-oriented, and aligned with The Future Perfect’s standards of service.

Recognize when a matter requires escalation to senior leadership, Legal, Sales leadership, or another

department, and provide a clear assessment of the issue, financial exposure, available options, and

recommended course of action.

Team Leadership \& Client Service Standards

Lead and develop the Client Services and Claims function, including direct reports responsible for day\-to\-

day client inquiries and claims casework.

Establish clear standards, workflows, and escalation protocols for post\-sale client concerns.

Guide and mentor Sales Assistants and other client\-facing team members on post\-sale communication,

including routine delays, product concerns, service recovery, and formal claims.

Help teams determine when a concern can be resolved directly, when Client Services should become

involved, and when leadership escalation is appropriate.

Provide coaching and feedback that strengthens judgment, communication skills, organization, ownership,

and independent problem solving across the team.

Promote a service culture in which clients feel cared for and well informed without automatically

committing The Future Perfect to financial responsibility before the facts have been established.

Financial Stewardship \& Recovery

Own and manage the Claims budget, including forecasting, tracking, reporting, and approval of resolutions

within established authority.

2Exercise sound judgment when balancing client goodwill, relationship value, contractual or warranty

considerations, operational practicality, and financial cost.

Identify and pursue appropriate recovery from vendors, artists, manufacturers, carriers, insurers, installers,

service providers, or other responsible parties before committing The Future Perfect resources wherever

reasonably possible.

Negotiate repair costs, replacements, credits, reimbursements, freight recovery, and other remedies with

external partners.

Track financial losses and recoveries associated with claims and post\-sale concerns and provide leadership

with clear visibility into claims expense and financial exposure.

Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary claims expense without compromising the quality of the client

**About Nowadays**
==================


We're building the future of in\-person connection, from intimate exec offsites to a conference\-level company offsite.


Nowadays is the first AI\-powered platform for planning corporate events. Our software handles everything from venue sourcing to vendor negotiations, making it easier and faster for teams to meet up in real life.


We've planned events across the globe for companies like Google, Airbnb, and Quantstamp, and we're just getting started.


Our mission is simple: make it easier for teams to create meaningful moments together.

**Who we are**
==============


We're a sister\-founded team based in San Francisco. We move fast, care deeply, and love bringing people together (whether it's a strategic offsite or a Friendsgiving in our Nowadays home).


We believe the best teams:

* Take ownership
* Keep things scrappy
* Celebrate wins (big and small)
* Genuinely enjoy working (\+ hanging out) together


Some of our favorite team excursions so far:

* Flying trapeze
* Steak\-offs at home
* Hauling a Christmas tree up to the office
* Hitting the spa after a big launch
* Racing an Ironman Relay

**What this role is**
=====================


This is a **zero\-to\-one operations role**. You'll take messy, fast\-moving workflows and turn them into systems that are simple, teachable, and scalable, without losing the human care that defines Nowadays.

**What you'll do**
==================

**80% of your time will focus on event operations and client communication**

* Own events end\-to\-end simultaneously, including clear written \+ verbal on\-brand client communication
* Own and evolve the end\-to\-end ops flow for running events, from first request to post\-event wrap
* Be the point person for prioritizing urgent vs non\-urgent ops issues
* Turn tribal knowledge into clear documentation, onboarding, and templates that anyone can use

**The remaining 20% of your time will focus on building for scale**

* Build scalable playbooks for: running a single complex event start\-to\-finish, and managing many events in parallel
* Partner closely with engineering to: translate customer feedback and bugs into clear product requirements and actionable tickets, and help test, validate, and refine tools before launch
* Create and maintain internal resources: ops onboarding docs, and client\-facing guides and templates for planning offsites
* Continuously identify what should be simplified, automated, or eliminated

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* You consistently put clients first, understanding that this can sometimes require late nights or weekend work
* You can juggle multiple workstreams and know how to prioritize quickly
* You're excellent at turning complexity into clarity
* You care deeply about process, but never at the expense of momentum
* Extreme attention to detail
* You're comfortable working across ops, product, dev, sales, and clients
* You communicate clearly, thoughtfully, and with good judgment
* You like building systems that other people can run
* You want to shape how a company operates, not just follow a playbook

**Bonus points**
================

* Startup zero\-to\-one experience
* Experience working with clients \+ owning client relationships
* Strong intuition for customer experience and boundaries
* Experience writing clear tickets in tools like Linear or Jira
* Comfort with basic SQL or data analysis to answer operational questions
* Comfort using AI/tools to replace manual, repetitive work

**Other details**
=================

**Location**

* In\-person in San Francisco

**Perks**

* Free lunch \+ dinner
* Quarterly team offsites (yes, we went to the White Lotus S3 hotel in Thailand), and exclusive access to top venues and events
* Monthly fitness stipend
* Health insurance
* 12 weeks paid parental leave
* Generous PTO with required time off to recharge
* High ownership, autonomy, and direct access to founders
* Access to top venues, events, and travel experiences

  

Compensation Range: $90K \- $130K

new_jobs.title: IT Service Desk & SLA Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
The IT Service Desk \& SLA Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of all IT support tickets, from initial intake through resolution and closure. This role demands unrelenting ownership: you will follow every ticket on its entire journey to the end\-of\-the\-earth to achieve resolution in a timely and effective manner.



Driven by a "Simple Sets You Free" mindset, this role actively strips away bureaucratic friction, eliminates operational waste, and continuously optimizes IT service management processes to maximize efficiency, speed up ticket resolution, and boost customer satisfaction.



### **In This Role, You Will...**


End\-to\-End Ticket Ownership \& Lifecycle Management
* Relentless Resolution Ownership: Personally track and follow tickets on their entire journey to the end\-of\-the\-earth, taking total responsibility until issues are thoroughly, accurately, and effectively resolved.

Queue Administration \& Triage: Monitor, triage, and assign incoming incidents, service requests, and problem tickets across multi\-tiered support teams with speed and accuracy.* Closure \& Quality Control: Validate that all tickets are properly documented, root causes are identified, and end\-users confirm resolution before ticket closure.
* Escalation Management: Identify aging, stuck, or high\-priority (P1/P2\) tickets and proactively cross organizational boundaries to drive action and prevent SLA breaches.


Process Optimization \& Friction Elimination ("Simple Sets You Free")
* Bottleneck Identification: Continuously audit ticket lifecycles, intake workflows, and escalation paths to pinpoint bottlenecks, redundant approvals, or process inefficiencies that delay issue reporting and resolution.
* Streamlined Workflows: Design and implement intuitive, simplified ticketing processes and self\-service channels that make it effortless for users to report issues and for technicians to resolve them.
* Root\-Cause Process Fixing: Collaborate across IT and business departments to re\-engineer flawed processes, remove unnecessary handoffs, and eliminate administrative bloat slowing down resolution times.
* Automation \& Lean Operations: Champion lean service desk practices by eliminating obsolete procedures, automating routine tasks, and establishing straightforward, zero\-friction standards across all support tiers.


SLA \& Metric Tracking
* SLA Monitoring: Enforce and monitor compliance against core SLAs (First Response Time, Mean Time to Resolution \[MTTR], First Contact Resolution \[FCR], and Customer Satisfaction \[CSAT]).
* Reporting \& Dashboards: Design, build, and maintain real\-time operational dashboards and weekly/monthly executive report packs using ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk).
* Trend Analysis: Analyze incident data to detect recurring technical issues, capacity bottlenecks, or process failures, feeding insights directly into Problem Management.


Process Governance \& Continuous Improvement
* ITIL \& Lean Governance: Standardize and enforce streamlined incident management processes, simplified escalation pathways, and consistent ticket categorization/tagging.
* Vendor \& Cross\-Team Coordination: Hold internal technical teams and external IT vendors accountable to contractual response and resolution targets while streamlining joint operational workflows.
* Customer Feedback: Manage the CSAT survey process, follow up on negative feedback, and implement actionable improvement plans based on direct user input.


### **Qualifications**

* 3–5\+ years in IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations, or Service Desk leadership roles with demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end ticket management and lean process optimization.
* Unwavering ownership mentality—willing to follow a ticket to the end\-of\-the\-earth to see it resolved.
* Strong lean operational mindset focused on process simplification and waste reduction.
* Advanced proficiency in ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, BMC Helix, Freshservice, etc.).
* Deep expertise in analytics/BI platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Excel/Google Sheets advanced reporting).

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification
* Excellent written/verbal communication
* Strong analytical problem\-solving
* Proven ability to simplify complex technical workflows under tight SLA timelines

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.
**About Zoox**
Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team.

**Flourish Airway Collective \| Danville, California**

Help children breathe, sleep, grow—and flourish.

Flourish Airway Collective is looking for an exceptionally warm, organized, and dependable person to become the welcoming heart of our practice.

This is not a traditional front\-desk position. Collaborating with internal support partners and resources, you'll ensure seamless execution of our solutions, contributing to Intuit's mission of disrupting the small business mid\-market segment.

------------


The Intuit Customer Success (ICS) Data Science \& Analytics team is seeking an exceptional Manager 2, Data Science to lead measurement of expert\-driven service excellence across our CG expert workforce. You will lead a team of data scientists covering five interlocking areas: expert\-driven conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities (work item management, scheduling, and appointments), training efficacy and expert upskilling strategy, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization across our Team of Experts.

  

Collaborating closely with VEP (Virtual Expert Platform), Expert Network, and Service Design leaders, you will build the measurement backbone needed to see and optimize service excellence end\-to\-end (E2E) at scale for CG — with a particular focus on conversion and customer\-serving time outcomes. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the future of customer success at Intuit as we build a service platform to empower our customers beyond core product use. This is your opportunity to join this exciting and transformational journey.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the measurement strategy across CG's expert service pillars — expert experiences conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities, training and upskilling, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization — in close partnership with VEP, Expert Network, and Service Design leaders.
* Advance causal inference and experimentation as a shared capability, establishing the causal relationship between service guidance, expert behavior, and outcomes like conversion and customer\-serving time.
* Contribute to a cross\-signal, causal\-graph decision engine that connects expert behavior, quality, and operational signals to size the impact of levers and inform roadmap and investment decisions.
* Build and govern the training and learning platform efficacy framework, connecting L\&D investment to expert quality and business outcomes.
* Partner with cross\-functional business leaders (e.g., VEP, Expert Network, Service Design, Service Delivery, Operations, Learning \& Development, Expert Engagement) to shape strategy, investment priorities, and reporting cadence (e.g., WBR, Redzone).
* Lead and develop a world\-class team of analysts and data scientists, coaching technical and strategic skill sets, especially in advanced analytics, applied data science, and modeling.
* Translate business and analytics strategies into multiple short\-term and long\-term projects, and manage end\-to\-end execution, including the creation of a metric framework for expert experiences and developing learning plans that connect training and service investments to expert experience metrics.
* Activate analytics insights that lead to decisions or better hypotheses, and evangelize innovative analytics ideas that enable new opportunities.
* Drive analytics rigor by inspecting and improving experimentation methodologies and techniques, and creating a learning culture.
* Drive the data roadmap from data quality to data visualization, and construct data models that enable E2E service excellence measurement.
* Role\-model "win\-together" while challenging the status quo and driving change across teams, regardless of organizational structure.

 **Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of diverse analytics and data science experience, including product analytics and customer/expert experience analytics.
* Proven experience leading a team of analysts and/or scientists.
* Strong passion for uncovering strategic opportunities and solving business problems.
* Prior hands\-on experience with advanced statistical analysis, controlled experimentation (including A/B testing of hierarchical mixed effects), and applied data science.

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.description:
**About Primer**
================


Primer is a growing network of K–8 schools restoring the timeless foundations of American education. Inspired by the original teaching primers that shaped a nation of readers, thinkers, and builders, our schools begin with what has always worked, and build for what lies ahead. Close\-knit learning environments. Skilled educators. A culture that takes kids seriously as learners and leaders.


Primers shaped the first 200 years of American children. Primer will ready them for the next.

**About the role**
------------------


As Primer’s Revenue Operations Lead, you will own the systems, processes, and reporting that move a family from their first interaction with Primer through their first day of school.


You will own Salesforce, HubSpot, our calling technology, and the reporting that the Growth team uses to manage enrollment performance. You will serve as the daily operating partner to the Head of Growth and act as the connective point between Marketing, Admissions, Product, and other cross\-functional partners, creating one reliable view of the enrollment funnel.


This is a hands\-on builder role. You will redesign our lead flow using native platform capabilities, establish the rhythm\-of\-business reporting that informs our decisions, and maintain a prioritized roadmap of the revenue\-system problems most worth solving.


This role has no direct reports today, but the function may grow underneath you as Primer scales.

  

**What you’ll do**
------------------

**Own our revenue systems**

* Own Salesforce, HubSpot, and the broader revenue technology stack, including architecture, administration, integrations, governance, and ongoing optimization
* Maintain strong data quality, clear system documentation, and consistent operating standards
* Translate business needs into technical requirements and prioritize solutions with Growth, Admissions, Marketing, and Product
* Lead testing, validation, deployment, and adoption for system enhancements

**Redesign the enrollment engine**

* Redesign our lead flow so each inquiry is routed correctly and the right source, campaign, campus, and family context reaches Admissions before the first conversation
* Move critical workflows away from middleware and toward reliable native platform integrations
* Evaluate, select, and implement Primer’s next calling and communications platform
* Improve lead routing, attribution, funnel visibility, and lifecycle\-stage governance across systems

**Build the operating system for growth**

* Build and maintain reporting across the full funnel, from lead generation through enrollment and the first day of school
* Establish the weekly and monthly reporting used to evaluate performance, diagnose funnel issues, and make resource decisions
* Bring clear insights and recommendations to monthly business reviews
* Build forecasting and capacity\-management tools in partnership with the Head of Growth
* Create one trusted view of performance across Marketing, Admissions, and campus capacity

**Improve how the team operates**

* Turn the practices of our strongest Admissions representatives into a documented playbook library that Admissions leadership can use for coaching and enablement
* Run a weekly operating cadence with Marketing, Admissions, Product, and other key partners
* Maintain a standing roadmap of system and process improvements, supported by research, impact assessments, and clear recommendations
* Proactively identify broken processes and bring forward solutions, not just status updates

 **What you’ll accomplish in your first 90 days**

* Map and document Primer’s full lead\-flow and revenue\-system architecture alongside the current systems owner
* Identify the highest\-risk gaps in routing, attribution, integrations, reporting, and data quality
* Align with the Head of Growth and key stakeholders on the future\-state design
* Ship the first phase of the lead\-flow and integration migration
* Launch the first version of Primer’s rhythm\-of\-business reporting and establish a weekly review cadence
* Publish a prioritized revenue operations roadmap with researched recommendations, expected impact, and proposed sequencing

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* Deep, hands\-on experience with both Salesforce and HubSpot, including relevant certifications
* A track record of personally building and administering systems, not solely managing vendors or designing from a distance
* Experience building or rebuilding a revenue engine within an early\-stage or rapidly scaling company
* Previous experience leading a sales or customer\-facing team, with a clear understanding of how systems affect representative performance and customer experience
* Experience supporting high\-consideration consumer sales, where customers are making a significant and personal decision
* Strong understanding of lead routing, attribution, lifecycle stages, data architecture, reporting, and funnel management
* The ability to turn ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, prioritized solutions, and shipped improvements
* A solutions\-oriented approach: when presented with several broken points, you research the options and return with a recommendation
* A systems mindset: you naturally think about where a lead enters, what information travels with it, how it changes over time, and what the representative needs to see

**Nice to have**

* Experience building forecasting, staffing, or capacity models
* Experience supporting a multi\-location or geographically distributed organization

### **Company Description**


**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**


Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.


Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.


### **Job Description**


We have an opening for an **Associate Program Leader** for the Counterterrorism (CT) group within the International Assessments (IA) Program to lead a dynamic team developing and executing the work of the Laboratory in support of intelligence missions in foreign nuclear weapons programs and threats involving radiological or nuclear (R/N) terrorism, and R/N materials. You will serve as a key member of the IA Program leadership team responsible for addressing workforce needs, safety, security, technical quality, standards, and project management to enhance the Laboratory's contributions to national security. In addition, you will substantively oversee the CT group’s analytic portfolio. This position is in the IA Program within Global Security Principal Directorate’s Z Program.  

  

**In this role, you will**

* Serve as a member of the IA Program leadership team, influencing the development and implementation of institutional objectives and goals.
* Provide technical and analytical leadership to technical staff to develop and provide subject matter expertise and analysis of foreign nuclear weapons programs and threats involving radiological or nuclear (R/N) terrorism, and R/N materials for multiple government sponsors.

* Provide project management oversight for the program’s analytic portfolio, including developing project execution plans and ensuring appropriate resource allocation, timelines, and review of the group’s deliverables.
* Assist in planning and direct activities for staffing of CT projects; manage program budget, allocate resources, determine qualification standards and attract, retain, recruit, and select staff with technical expertise.
* Lead performance management and career development activities for all members of the CT group, including conducting quarterly check\-in and regular 1:1 meetings, writing performance reviews, and providing input for matrix personnel. * Influence strategic decisions made by senior management and external customers at the national level.

**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


Ramp builds software that moves real money, from bill payments and corporate cards to reimbursements, accounting integrations, and travel. Our customers rely on us to keep their operations running: invoices get paid, books get closed, and finance leaders can trust the data behind every decision.


In this role, you will be the person who spots where customers are getting stuck and drives issues to a clear resolution. You will learn a complex product deeply enough to troubleshoot across payments, bank linking, accounting syncs, and card programs, then partner with teams across Engineering, Risk, Product, and Partnerships to get problems solved. This is not script\-based support. You will triage, investigate, and make high\-signal judgment calls throughout the day.


You will thrive in this role if you are a systems thinker and deeply customer obsessed. Support is the baseline. How you think about improving processes, tools, and outcomes is what sets you apart.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Be the voice of Ramp's Customer Support.** You'll spend your day engaging with customers, primarily via live calls, email, and chat.
* **Diagnose across a broad product surface.** Ramp isn't one product — it's payments, cards, travel, accounting integrations, and more. You'll need to understand how they connect and where they break.
* **Operate with an ownership mindset, managing escalations end\-to\-end.** You take full accountability for every ticket you handle. When an issue crosses team boundaries — risk, engineering, product, partnerships — you route it correctly, follow up, and make sure the customer isn't left waiting. You'll work across Zendesk, internal tooling, and Slack\-based escalation workflows.
* **Build and shape AI tools, not just use them.** Ramp is building AI into CX operations. You'll use AI\-powered research tools and proprietary tools like Glass daily, provide direct feedback on what's working, and play an active role in how these tools evolve. * **Communicate with precision and empathy.** Our customers are financially sophisticated. You need to explain what's happening, what you're doing about it, and what they should expect — clearly and without filler.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* You're a systems thinker: you don't just solve the ticket in front of you, you ask why the problem exists and how to prevent it from happening again.
* You actively use AI tools — Claude, Notion AI, research and workflow tools — and can demonstrate how you've applied them to get real work done. This is a hard requirement.
* You're fast\-moving while holding yourself to a high bar for execution: you balance speed, accuracy, and thoroughness in every interaction.
* You can hold a technical conversation about how systems connect (APIs, bank integrations, accounting software) even if you're not writing code.
* You manage competing priorities without dropping things. When you have 15 open issues across 4 internal teams, nothing falls through.
* You write clearly and concisely. You can explain a payment reconciliation issue to a CFO without jargon.
* You're comfortable on the phone. Many interactions start there.
* You have a demonstrated track record of exceeding key performance standards, including CSAT, QA, and speed\-of\-service metrics.

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Experience building workflows or automations using AI tools, not just prompting
* Familiarity with accounting workflows (AP/AR, GL, reconciliation) or ERP integrations (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage)
* Background in payments infrastructure (ACH, wire transfers, card networks)
* Track record of working somewhere that shipped product fast and expected CX to keep up

**Why be a CX Associate at Ramp**
---------------------------------

* **Cross\-functional exposure from day one.** You work directly with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams — not siloed into a support queue.
* **AI tools and unlimited access.** Unlimited tokens, proprietary AI tools like Glass, and a culture that expects you to use them to move faster and build smarter.
* **Career growth that you own.** Grow within CX, explore other functions internally, or carve out a path that doesn't exist yet. If you're invested, we're invested.
* **Culture that's different from a call center.** Team events, in\-person offsites, and a genuine commitment to building a team people want to be part of.

-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

------------------

We're building for a future where AI dramatically amplifies what strategy teams can accomplish. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.

Experience working with and analyzing data.  
* 

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Advanced degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience managing multiple projects.
* Experience working with product and engineering teams.

**About the job**
-----------------


Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.



In this role, you will help shape the future of education by joining the newly formed Central Strategy and Operations team within the Education Unit. You will partner with cross\-functional teams—including GTM, PgM, Data Science, PM, Engineering, and UXR—and collaborate across Product Areas to create a cohesive user experience across multiple surfaces and AI offerings. You will apply business excellence and strategic structure to drive forward one of Google’s highest\-priority initiatives.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $126000 \- $180000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**

* Establish and manage the operational rhythm across GTM, Marketing, Communications, and Product teams. Facilitate alignment forums, monitor priority workstreams, and drive follow\-through on key strategic initiatives.

new_jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role, including experience building algorithmic, machine learning, or infrastructure platforms.
* 3 years of experience in Trust and Safety, web spam detection, anti\-abuse, or platform integrity.
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.
* Experience building product defenses against adversarial ML risks (e.g., prompt injection, data poisoning), synthetic text generation, or agentic automation.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning (ML), NLP, or a related quantitative field.
* 3 years of experience working with Policy and Legal teams to develop policies and communications for anti\-abuse, spam, or trust and safety products.
* Experience with search ecosystems (e.g., web crawling, indexing pipelines, information retrieval, and link\-graph analysis) with a track record of publishing research or leading industry consortia against web abuse.
* Experience communicating complex concepts to internal and external audiences, and navigating high\-ambiguity technical challenges from concept to production deployment at a multi\-million or billion\-user scale.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


Google Search is dedicated to organizing the world’s information and making it universally accessible and useful. Maintaining user trust requires protecting Search from increasingly sophisticated adversarial threats. The proliferation of Generative AI, automated synthetic content networks, LLM\-driven parasite SEO, and agentic scraping has fundamentally transformed web spam from simple keyword manipulation into complex, automated adversarial campaigns.


As a Senior Product Manager for Google Search Anti\-Spam and Abuse, you will define and drive the multi\-year product strategy, technical architecture, and algorithmic defense mechanisms to combat AI\-driven abuse at a global scale. You will partner closely with Research Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Regulatory and Policy Experts, Anti\-Abuse experts, and Operations teams to ensure Search delivers high\-quality, authentic information.


In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $192000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and drive the multi\-year product strategy, goal, and project roadmaps for combating spam and adversarial threats on Search, securing buy\-in from cross\-functional teams.
* Lead PRDs and collaborate with Engineering and Analyst partner teams to operationalize mechanisms that proactively detect abuse trends, combat spam, and manage incidents for deviations from expected system behavior.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Policy, Legal, Trust and Safety, and Threat Intelligence to codify emerging abuse vectors and execute mitigation plans aligned with regulatory obligations.
* Build and own Go\-To\-Market (GTM) and comprehensive proactive/reactive communication plans for defense rollouts and policy updates.
* Define and own success metrics for anti\-abuse initiatives by leading processes to collect, track, and harmonize quantitative and qualitative product metrics.

new_jobs.description:
**ISSA is seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Associate contractor to directly support Health Coach Institute (HCI), part of the ISSA family of brands.** **While this position is posted through ISSA’s career network, your day\-to\-day focus, campaigns, and audience engagement will be dedicated specifically to HCI's programs and student lifecycle.** **This is a fixed\-term contract position scheduled through December 2026\.** **About HCI:** At Health Coach Institute (HCI), we empower purpose\-driven individuals to transform lives through human\-centered, science\-based coaching education. For over a decade, we’ve set the standard in health and life coach certification by blending behavioral psychology, habit\-change methodology, and practical business skills. Whether your goal is to build a thriving private practice or earn top\-tier industry credentials, HCI provides the accredited training, hands\-on practice, and ongoing support you need to make a meaningful, lasting impact.**So What's the Job?**  

As the **Lifecycle Marketing Associate contractor,** you will provide executional support to the Sr. Brand Manager, turning the lifecycle marketing and promo strategy into deployed reality. The Associate builds, QAs, and sends email and SMS campaigns in HubSpot, keeps the lifecycle nurture program updated/running day\-to\-day, and grows into owning audience segmentation over time. This is a hands\-on execution role, not a strategy\-setting one — strategy is set by the Sr. Brand Manager; this role makes it happen on schedule and error\-free.* **Campaign Execution \& QA:** Build, QA, and deploy email and SMS campaigns in HubSpot—including promos, webinar sequences, nurture flows, and one\-off sends—on schedule and error\-free.
* **Testing \& Optimization:** Design and run A/B tests across email/SMS campaigns and audience segmentation to optimize performance.
* **Email Calendar Management:** Build and maintain an organized month\-to\-month email calendar to ensure strategic clarity and operational alignment across the organization.
* **Lifecycle Nurture Execution:** Execute and manage the email/SMS lifecycle nurture framework (0–30, 30–60, 60–90, and 90\+ day segments) as defined by the Sr. Brand Manager.
* **Nurture Program Development:** Build and launch new nurture workflows to support evolving business and marketing needs.
* **List Hygiene \& Segmentation:** Build, maintain, and continuously improve audience segmentation and list hygiene as HubSpot data models and properties evolve.
* **Webinar Comms Management:** Support the six\-email webinar communications sequence (from registration confirmation through replay delivery) end to end.
* **Deployment QA Discipline:** Thoroughly QA every send before deployment, including link verification, personalization tokens, segmentation/list targeting, and deliverability fundamentals.
* **Promo Calendar Support:** Assist with promo calendar execution—including banners, send scheduling, and adherence to payment links and pricing structures.
* **Performance Monitoring \& Reporting:** Track core campaign metrics (open rates, click\-through rates, conversion rates) and flag anomalies or opportunities to the Sr. Brand Manager. Pull and analyze email performance data on a month\-to\-month basis to track overall email health, deliverability, and channel engagement trends
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner with the broader marketing and social media teams to ensure campaign timing and messaging remain cohesive across all channels.

**What is ISSA/HCI looking for?*** **Hands\-on HubSpot Expertise:** Experience building and deploying email/SMS campaigns and automated workflows directly in HubSpot (hands\-on execution, not observational experience).
* **Track Record of Execution:** Proven ability to take a brief and deliver a fully built, thoroughly tested, and deployed campaign with minimal supervision.
* **Strong Segmentation Aptitude:** Comfortable working directly with audience lists, custom properties, and behavior\-based segmentation logic.
* **High Attention to Detail \& QA Discipline:** Meticulous approach to quality control—success in this role is judged on error\-free sends, not just on\-time deployments.
* **Exceptional Organizational Skills:** Ability to keep campaigns, timelines, and deliverables structured and on track in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable navigating a fast\-moving, evolving marketing calendar with shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
* **Proactive Communication:** Clear, effective communicator who actively flags blockers, risks, and QA issues well in advance of send dates.

**Nice to have:**

* Prior experience specifically with lifecycle/nurture email programs (not just one\-off campaign sends).
* Familiarity with email deliverability fundamentals (sender reputation, list hygiene, spam triggers).
* Experience supporting webinar or live\-event communications sequences.
* Exposure to SMS marketing platforms/compliance basics (opt\-in/opt\-out handling).

**Success in this role looks like:*** Every scheduled send goes out on time, correctly segmented, and free of broken links or personalization errors.
* The Sr. Brand Manager can hand off a campaign brief and trust it will be built and deployed without rework.
* Growing ownership of segmentation strategy — from executing existing segments to proposing improvements.

 **Compensation:** $40 an hour**Hours per week:** 40
